It defines seven required study dimensions: protection objective, physical scope, observability, timing and decision windows, targets and sample validity, validation protocol, and evaluation outputs. The framework is instantiated in a bounded case study on the public PROTECT-90 electromagnetic-transient benchmark, comprising 9022 simulated episodes from a 90 kV double-line topology, for onset-conditioned fault classification and localization. Under centralized sensing, simulation-metadata-aligned 20 ms windows, and episode-grouped validation, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) achieved a five-fold mean macro-averaged F1 score of 0.991 +/- 0.001 for classification and a localization mean absolute error of 10.20 +/- 0.25% of line length (mean +/- std across episode-grouped folds). Extending the decision horizon to 50 ms preserved this task-dependent performance asymmetry, while reduced observability approximately doubled the MLP localization error but had little effect on classification. A synchronized two-ended conventional locator outperformed the learning locators under its richer clean information set, and measurement degradation showed that clean predictive performance did not determine robustness. The framework turns evaluation assumptions into explicit, reproducible evidence and provides a basis for more comparable, auditable evaluation and future certification-oriented assessment of machine-learning protection functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向机器学习电力系统保护研究的标准化评估框架，定义七个必备研究维度（保护目标、物理范围、可观测性、时序决策窗口、目标与样本有效性、验证协议、评估输出），并通过 PROTECT-90 公开 EMT 基准上的故障分类（FC）与故障定位（FL）案例研究验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前 ML 保护领域研究普遍报告接近完美的分数，但这些分数的实际含义强依赖于评估设定——保护任务、物理范围、测量方式、时序、目标、预处理和验证方法往往同时变化且未充分说明。不同研究在相同任务名义下实际评估的是不同的推理问题，导致算法进展与任务难度差异无法区分，工程知识难以累积。本文将评估设计从中性实验背景提升为科学贡献的核心部分，解决这一结构性问题。
AI.method: 方法包含两个层面：(1) 框架层面——提出七步骤评估协议（保护目标→物理系统范围→可观测性→时序与决策窗口→目标与有效样本→训练与验证协议→评估输出与诊断），并设计对应的标准化报告包，涵盖 IEC 60255 保护测试标准与 AI 保障标准；(2) 案例研究层面——在 PROTECT-90 基准（90 kV 双线拓扑，9022 个 EMT 仿真 episode）上实例化框架，中心化全可观测参考配置下使用 20 ms/128 样本窗口（5 ms 步长）、起始条件约束的 11 类 FC 和归一化 FL 目标，按 episode 分组五折交叉验证，对比 MLP、GB、KNN、Ridge、CNN1D、MOMENT-1-large 基础模型及传统阻抗定位法，并通过控制变量方式分析时序、可观测性、测量保真度（噪声/CT 饱和/同步抖动）、故障电阻分布偏移、步长与超参数敏感性。
AI.result: 1) 在 20 ms 参考配置下，MLP 获 FC 宏平均 F1=0.991±0.001，FL MAE=10.20±0.25% 线长，揭示分类与定位间的任务依赖性性能不对称；2) 延长至 50 ms 保持此不对称；3) 降低可观测性（单继电器）使定位误差约翻倍但对分类影响有限；4) 双端同步传统定位器在更丰富信息集下优于学习型定位器；5) 测量退化表明干净性能不能预测鲁棒性，MLP 定位误差在 CT 饱和下膨胀约 2.4 倍而 GB 更稳健，但分类任务排序反转；6) 跨模型家族（MLP、CNN1D、MOMENT）验证了任务级结论的普遍性；7) 故障定位误差在空间上不均匀（中段最低、端部最高）。
AI.conclusion: 报告性能并非模型本身的属性，而是评估设定的函数。所提七步骤框架将评估假设转化为可审查、可复现的证据，使比较单位从孤立算法转向完整推理问题。案例研究展示一旦维度明确，分类与定位的不对称即可观测且不依赖模型选择。框架本身不构成部署认证，但为未来走向保护功能认证导向评估提供了可审计、可比较的研究基础。局限包括仅覆盖单一 90 kV 双线拓扑、参考配置假设噪声自由同步测量、未涵盖通信延迟与安全关键非故障事件，框架未来需扩展至更广拓扑、实测数据与端到端延迟分析。

title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation
summary: Technical documentation is written for human developers, but an increasing share of software changes is now authored by autonomous coding agents. Which documents they consult, when, and what follows remain unknown. We conduct a behaviour-grounded study of agent-documentation interaction across two public datasets: 557 agentic coding sessions from SWE-chat, yielding 94,813 development events including 3,033 documentation interactions; and 33,097 agentic pull requests from AIDev, with 690,260 classified file-level change records. Four findings challenge current documentation practice. First, agents' documentation work is dominated by agent-facing artefacts: instruction files and working notes account for 60.5% of all documentation interactions, versus 10.6% for classical technical documentation and 1.3% for API references. Second, the link between consultation and code editing is unresolved: the adjacent transition probability is 0.002 and the unadjusted three-event lift 1.05, whereas a stage-adjusted model places it above unity (OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]); documentation creation is elevated unadjusted (lift 1.67) but its adjusted interval includes unity. Third, no explicit documentation-based validation sequence was observed, and consultation is associated with less immediate testing (lift 0.23, cluster CI 0.08-0.45; adjusted OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]). Fourth, consultation is self-initiated (70.2%) far more often than failure-driven (7.5%), and documentation trails code: among multi-commit pull requests changing both, code is touched first 4.7x more often. From these traces we derive a descriptive model of agent-documentation interaction as a two-lobed cycle rather than a linear journey, and show that two widely assumed properties of "agent-friendly" documentation - actionability and verifiability - lack consistent behavioural support. We release our pipeline, coding scheme, and event-level data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过追踪557个真实智能体编码会话（SWE-chat，94,813个开发事件，3,033个文档交互）和33,097个智能体拉取请求（AIDev，690,260条文件级变更记录）的行为数据,系统研究了自主编码智能体如何发现、阅读和编写技术文档。核心发现是智能体文档交互的主体是"面向智能体的制品"（指令文件35.4% + 工作笔记25.1% = 60.5%）,而非传统API参考（1.3%）或故障排查文档（0.4%）；且"读取文档→编写代码→验证"这一被广泛假设的线性流程在行为数据中缺乏一致支持。
AI.motivation: 现有的软件文档研究以人类开发者为预设读者，文档质量框架和陈旧度度量均假设存在有意图、会困惑、会请教同事的读者。然而，越来越多的代码变更由无人在环的自主编码智能体自动生成并提交PR。当前关于"智能体友好"文档的实践建议（如 llms.txt、清晰的标题、可运行的示例）均基于智能体"应该"如何行为的直觉，而非对其实际行为的观察。本研究的核心动机是：智能体究竟在什么时候、查阅哪些文档、查阅之后会做什么？这些基础问题在现有文献中尚无行为层面的证据。
AI.method: 研究采用双数据集互补设计：(1) SWE-chat提供"过程"证据——557个会话、四种异构转录格式，统一抽取为20个符号的事件字母表，最终得到94,813个事件和3,033个文档交互，按四维编码（文档类型/交互类型/触发器/结果）；(2) AIDev提供"制品"证据——33,097个智能体PR的690,260条文件级变更记录。文档识别采用两层分类器：第1层为基于路径规则的确定性分类（15种文档类型），第2层用LLM标注527条歧义路径中的500条（98.4%），揭示出"智能体工作笔记"这一原分类法未涵盖的新类别。统计推断采用会话/仓库层面的聚类bootstrap（2,000次重抽样）作为主要不确定性估计，并以考虑发展阶段的logistic GEE调整模型作为补充。三项研究问题分别针对文档类型与阶段、检索前后的上下文动作、以及代码-文档的双向循环。
AI.result: 研究发现对现有文档实践提出四项挑战：(1) 文档类型分布反转——面向智能体的制品占60.5%，经典技术文档仅10.6%，API参考1.3%，故障排查0.4%；(2) 读取-编码关联不稳定——相邻事件转移概率仅0.002，三事件窗口非调整lift为1.05，但阶段调整后OR为1.33 [1.09, 1.62]，文档创建的非调整lift为1.67但调整后区间包含1；(3) 文档验证完全缺失——零个"读取文档→测试/构建"序列被观测到，且文档检索与较少的即时测试相关（lift 0.23, OR 0.39 [0.25, 0.60]）；(4) 文档交互为智能体自发（70.2%）而非失败驱动（7.5%），且文档在时间上滞后于代码，在多提交PR中代码先被修改的频率是文档的4.7倍。基于此，论文提出"双叶循环"描述模型取代线性模型：包含内部递归的"咨询叶"（检索→检索概率0.270，检索→推理0.245）和独立的"生产叶"（贡献/更新1,401个事件），两叶之间仅有松散耦合。智能体自身的活动会回写至AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md等指令文件，形成从输出到输入的封闭回路。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三点结论：(1) 实践层面应重新分配文档资源——改进智能体指令文件的潜在覆盖面约为API参考的27倍；(2) 研究层面，文档现在拥有两类行为可测且差异显著的读者，新读者（智能体）的写入量与读取量几乎相当（生产/咨询 = 0.87）；(3) 当下被广泛倡导的"可操作性"与"可验证性"两项智能体友好文档属性，在本语料中缺乏一致的行为证据支持。研究同时指出文档类型分类器（尤其是 agent_working_note 类别）尚需人类编码验证、文档工作记忆假说与测试预言假说有待区分，并呼吁未来通过干预研究验证文档设计建议。论文发布抽取流水线、编码方案和事件级数据。

title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Code, weights and the measurement artefacts behind every number: this https URL
summary: Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards. We did the opposite: we fixed the target first, one user, one token at a time, 4-bit weights, ordinary CPU, and chose the architecture to suit it. The result keeps full attention in only 6 of its 18 blocks. The other 12 use short convolutions whose memory is two timesteps wide no matter how long the conversation gets, so two thirds of the network never re-reads a growing cache. Trained from scratch on 59.9B tokens, the model scores 47.31 on a five-task benchmark against a bar of 42.20 that was fixed before training began. It beats GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M, OPT-125M and GPT-neo-125M, all trained on three to six times more data, and exceeds MobileLLM-125M's published score despite that model seeing a trillion tokens. Validation bits-per-byte is 0.8685. To check the architecture rather than the training recipe, we trained a conventional all-attention model of the same size on the same data, and wrote down the winning condition before scoring either. The hybrid won the chosen quality metric by 0.81%, matched it on downstream tasks, produced a 6.3% smaller 4-bit file, and decoded 1.76x faster at 2048 tokens of context, 2.08x against an external model of similar size. In every measurement the speed advantage is near zero at an empty context and grows with length, which is what the mechanism predicts and what a merely leaner model would not show. A simple bandwidth calculation predicts only 1.17x, so memory volume alone does not explain the gap. We also report what did not work: an unmitigated 4-bit quality cost, roughly half the convolution channels ending up inert and impossible to remove, and a vocabulary larger than this model size warrants.

AI.tldr: Daedalus-150M 是一个 1.6 亿参数的卷积-注意力混合架构小型语言模型，专为单用户 CPU 推理场景设计。其 18 个块中仅有 6 个使用完整注意力，其余 12 个使用状态恒定的短卷积（仅 2 个时间步），从而避免了键值缓存随上下文线性增长的问题。在仅 59.9B token 训练数据上，该模型在五任务基准上取得 47.31 分（预注册基线 42.20），并在 2048 token 上下文下实现 1.76×（内部对照）和 2.08×（外部对照）的解码加速。
AI.motivation: 在 batch size 为 1 的 CPU 推理场景下，传统的全注意力解码器存在三个关键问题：(1) 无批处理可分摊权重加载开销，每个 token 都需流式读取权重；(2) 内存带宽先于计算成为瓶颈，架构应优化"每 token 读取字节数"而非算力；(3) 键值缓存随上下文线性增长，在长对话/长文档场景下成为主要延迟来源。作者认为大多数层应使用固定大小状态而非增长状态，使解码成本在上下文长度上更平坦，从而在用户实际感知延迟的长上下文场景中获得优势。
AI.method:
核心方法是从部署目标倒推架构设计：
1. **架构设计**：18 个块中 12 个为短卷积块（depthwise conv1d，kernel=3，门控机制 B⊙x 和 C⊙y，状态仅 2 个时间步），6 个为注意力块（位于索引 4,7,9,11,13,16，使用 GQA：12 查询头 / 4 KV 头）。嵌入与 LM head 权重绑定。
2. **预注册对照实验**：构建参数量匹配（差异<0.5%）的 24 层全注意力密集对照组（d=640, FFN=2304），在相同数据和调度下各训练 5B token，决策规则（验证 bpb 提升 ≥0.5% 为胜）提前固定。
3. **数据策略**：10 个英文数据源共 16.93B 唯一 token，每源最多重复 4 次（water-filling 重分配），shard 文件级别 2% 留出。
4. **训练配置**：124,476 步，59.9B token；Muon 优化二维权重矩阵（122.68M 参数），AdamW 优化嵌入/范数/偏置（37.81M 参数）；WSD 调度，最后 45% 线性衰减至 0；单卡 RTX 5090，bf16。
5. **量化**：4-bit Q4_0 格式，未采用量化感知训练（因失败）。
AI.result:
主要结果：
1. **质量**：五任务均分 47.31 vs 预注册基线 42.20，超越 GPT-2 124M、OPT-125M、GPT-neo-125M、Pythia-160M 和 MobileLLM-125M（万亿 token 训练）。验证 bpb = 0.8685。
2. **架构消融**：混合架构在预注册指标（bpb）上以 0.81% 优势胜出（超过 0.5% 阈值），下游任务持平；4-bit 文件小 6.3%；2048 token 解码速度 1.76×（内部对照）、2.08×（外部 135M 参数对照）。速度优势在深度 0 时接近 1.0×，随上下文单调增长——验证了机制而非"模型更精简"的解释。
3. **成本模型验证**：一阶带宽模型仅预测 1.17× 优势，实测 1.76×，差距归因于注意力 softmax 归约的延迟受限特性（而非纯带宽）以及密集对照组多 6 层带来的固定开销。
4. **负面结果**：约 47.9% 卷积通道在训练后完全惰性（约 13.6M 参数），但因推理运行时检查张量维度无法裁剪；量化感知训练首次步产生非有限损失被禁用；词表（49,152）相对 150M 模型过大（理想为 24-32k）。
5. **局限性**：单 seed、仅英语、训练混合与目标 L1 距离 10.42（超 10.0 阈值）、训练中断恢复后优化器状态丢失、最后 4.8B token 来自较小语料快照。
AI.conclusion: 核心命题得到验证：在 batch size=1 的 CPU 解码场景下，将三分之二的注意力层替换为固定状态短卷积，可在不牺牲质量的前提下获得显著的速度优势。预注册对照实验表明，混合架构在选定的质量指标上以 0.81% 优势胜出，下游任务持平，4-bit 文件小 6.3%，2048 token 解码快 1.76×（内部）/2.08×（外部）。速度优势随上下文深度单调增长，与"避免增长的键值缓存"的机制解释一致，纯字节带宽模型仅能解释其中一部分（1.17×）。剩余开放问题均为工程层面而非架构层面：量化感知训练失败、约半数卷积通道惰性、词表过大，三者均更适合在下一代模型的设计阶段而非本模型的修补中解决。

title: Inject, Align, Recover: Staged Post-Training for Retrieval-Free Document Knowledge Internalization
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Includes Supplementary Material Sections A--G. Qian Kou and Xiaofeng Shi contributed equally and are co-corresponding authors. Hua Zhou is the project leader
summary: Large language models often fail to answer questions about a bounded document collection when the source documents are not retrieved at inference time. We study this setting as document knowledge internalization: converting a fixed corpus into usable parametric knowledge for retrieval-free question answering. We propose IAR (Inject, Align, and Recover), a three-stage post-training framework that separates structured document knowledge injection, QA behavior alignment, and general ability recovery. Unlike conventional continued pretraining, Inject converts source documents into continuation, rewrite, and instruction-conditioned reconstruction objectives. Align then adapts the injected model with answer-only QA supervision, while Recover merges the domain-adapted model with the base instruction model to recover general capabilities. Across Common Corpus (CC) and CCI, and across Llama, Phi, Qwen, and SmolLM model families, IAR improves the domain-primary domain-general frontier for retrieval-free document internalization. In the main comparison, IAR improves over Vanilla SFT on all four reported metrics in 7 of 8 dataset-model settings, with average gains of 3.6 percentage points in domain QA accuracy and 12.1 percentage points in mean general performance across IFEval, MMLU, and MSBench. Extended CC baselines show that LoRA and FAPM can win individual general metrics, but among methods that also reach leading or near-leading domain internalization, IAR retains one of the strongest general profiles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IAR（Inject, Align, Recover）三阶段后训练框架，将文档知识内化（无需检索即可回答文档相关问题）分解为结构化文档注入、QA 对齐和通用能力恢复三个独立阶段。实验表明，IAR 在 CC 和 CCI 数据集、跨 Llama/Phi/Qwen/SmolLM 多个模型族上，显著推进了领域准确率与通用能力保留之间的 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在推理阶段无检索条件下，往往难以回答 bounded document collection 相关的问题。传统方案如 Vanilla SFT 仅基于 QA 对监督、信号稀疏；CPT 直接建模文档流但未教授 QA 接口；两者均面临领域适应与灾难性遗忘之间的权衡。本文将"文档知识内化"视为一个领域-通用能力的操作点问题，而非单一指标优化问题，主张需要分离地处理文档暴露、QA 可访问性和能力保留三个子问题。
AI.method: IAR 框架包含三个阶段：(1) Inject：将文档转换为三类指令条件下的监督重建目标——续写（continuation）、改写（rewrite，从摘要/大纲/骨架重建全文）、指令格式化重建（短指令→全文），损失仅作用于助手目标，区别于原始 CPT；(2) Align：在 Inject 检查点基础上用 answer-only QA 微调，使用问题-答案监督；(3) Recover：从 IA 检查点与原始 Instruct 模型出发，使用现有后验权重空间算子（SLERP、Task Arithmetic、TIES、DARE）进行合并，按域准确率为首要目标、IFEval/MMLU/MSBench 为护线在固定 12 候选网格中选出验证集上的操作点（τ=1.0pp 容差），再用保留测试集评估。文中提出统一目标视角，将 Inject 视为混合分布下的文档生成损失，并明确与 CPT 损失的区别。
AI.result: 在 CC（14,258 训练/750 测试）与 CCI（10,926/575）上，4 个模型族共 8 个主设置中：IAR 在 7/8 设置的全部 4 项指标上超过 Vanilla SFT，域 QA 平均提升 +3.6pp，通用能力均值提升 +12.1pp；Inject+Align（恢复前）在全部 8 个设置上均改善域准确率；CCI Qwen3-4B 因基础模型对源文分布已有强匹配（70.6% 起始域准确率与最低 BPB）而呈现高基线先验边界情形；Qwen3 8B/14B/32B 缩放中，TIES d=0.3 稳定在距 Best IA 域分仅 1.1pp 内，同时均恢复 14.9–24.1pp 的通用性能。Token 预算对照（BudgetMatch）显示单纯延长 QA 训练仅解释部分 CC 收益，CCI 上 IAR 仍 4/4 全指标胜出。LoRA/FAPM 在个别通用指标上更强但域内化不足。
AI.conclusion: IAR 是对文档内化适应预算的受控经验分解，而非统一最优的单一配方。它通过将文档暴露、QA 对齐和后验能力恢复分离，提供了可解释的操作点选择机制。Inject+Align 在所有主设置中带来恢复前的域增益；Recover 在保留大部分域准确率的同时恢复大幅通用能力，且跨 Qwen3 缩放保持一致模式。整体结论：阶段式暴露与恢复是强而设置依赖的操作点，部署偏好（域准确率优先 vs. 通用能力优先）仍影响最终选择。

title: Inducing Task Models from Computer-Use Traces
summary: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks are actually performed, and organizations need to audit and reuse that knowledge. However, inducing such task models is challenging, as activity is observed only as low-level events and real-world work is multi-threaded with interleaved goals. Existing methods assume a given task or a single workflow, and produce step-level summaries rather than structured task models. We introduce Task Model Induction (TMI), which (i) discovers the latent tasks in an unconstrained trace, disentangling concurrent activity, and (ii) for each latent task, induces a task model pairing a hierarchical objective model of recursive goal decomposition with a procedure model of the control flow that organized the execution. Intrinsically, on controlled human and agent trajectories, TMI recovers interleaved tasks with 0.974 agreement against ground-truth groupings and reconstructs 74.9% of the observed execution steps, far more than the strongest workflow induction baseline. Extrinsically, skills derived from TMI's task models improve held-out task accuracy by 30.0% over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务模型归纳（Task Model Induction, TMI），从自然计算机使用轨迹（屏幕截图与鼠标键盘事件）中自动发现潜在任务并为每个任务构建融合目标层级与控制流结构的任务模型，实现对多线程、交叉执行工作的可审计、可复用的符号化表征。
AI.motivation: 随着计算机使用代理进入真实工作场景，需要从人类操作痕迹中提炼任务如何完成的知识；但现有方法存在三个局限：(1) 信号层面——原始事件（光标移动、按键、像素）缺乏语义；(2) 结构层面——真实工作是多线程交叉的；(3) 表示层面——现有方法要么假设任务已知，要么仅产出扁平步骤摘要，无法表达目标层次与控制流（迭代、分支），因此需要一种能在无任何先验标签下自动恢复潜在任务及其结构化模型的框架。
AI.method: TMI 由三个阶段组成：(1) 事件基础化与活动分割——视觉-语言模型根据前后截图将每个原始事件语义化，再向后切分为"语义动作"，向前合并为"活动"；(2) 潜在任务归纳——增量式地将每个活动分配到最相似的现有任务（或新建任务），通过任务画像（摘要+引用标识符）维持任务跨应用/命名的连贯性，并进行全局合并；(3) 任务模型构建——对每个任务独立诱导目标模型（递归分解的层级，使用计算思维范式）与过程模型（基于结构化程序定理，仅保留可观察的 sequence、for-each、while 操作符），随后在形式有效性约束下将两者调和为统一树形模型，每个节点同时承载目标与控制流操作符。实现使用 gpt-5.4 作为基础模型。
AI.result: 内在评估：在 126 条合成多任务轨迹上（K=2–15，d=2–4），潜在任务分组的平均调整兰德指数（ARI）达 0.974，MAE 仅 0.48；在 38 段真实人类会话上任务身份匹配率 94.74%（gpt-5.5 评判）/89.47%（claude-sonnet-5），在 SkillsBench 74 段成功运行中达 93.24%/98.65%。任务模型保真度上，步骤描述准确率 74.9%，远高于最强基线工作流摘要的 30.3%，操作符正确率达 88.5%；消融显示去除目标模型或过程模型均显著下降，独立诱导再调和优于一次性联合诱导（后者产生的有效节点数仅为前者一半）。外在评估：在 SkillLearnBench 上，由 TMI 任务模型生成的技能使保留任务准确率从最强基线 14.29% 提升至 18.57%，相对提升 30.0%，可执行性从 59.35 提升到 67.65。
AI.conclusion: TMI 是首个能够从无约束的计算机使用轨迹中自动联合发现潜在任务并构建融合目标层级与控制流的任务模型的方法，显著优于现有工作流归纳基线；其诱导出的任务模型不仅忠实地恢复了交叉执行的结构（含错误修复、探索、回溯等非线性行为），还能转化为可复用的代理技能，带来下游任务准确率的实质性提升；研究局限包括对含个人信息的原始屏幕/键盘数据需做隐私脱敏，其对归纳质量的影响留待未来工作。

title: G-CARL: Grounded Checklist-Aligned Reward Learning for Patient-Oriented Medical Report Interpretation
summary: Personalized interpretation of medical reports has emerged as an increasingly important need among patients. Addressing this need requires both evidence-grounded medical factuality and context-dependent patient communication, yet existing medical vision-language tasks do not adequately capture these dual requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce Patient-oriented Medical Report Interpretation (PMRI), a novel open-ended multimodal generation task that requires models to explain medical reports in accurate and accessible language based on a user's query and dialogue history. These two objectives differ fundamentally in their verifiability, yet remain tightly coupled, making them difficult to optimize jointly under conventional supervised fine-tuning and holistic reinforcement learning paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose G-CARL, a grounded, checklist-aligned reinforcement learning framework that combines multi-source retrieval for atomic claim verification with context-aware, instance-specific weighted checklists for response coverage, providing structured supervision for factuality, user-demand satisfaction, and expression quality without constraining response diversity. We further construct MMedReport, a real-world PMRI benchmark, along with a clinician-designed three-dimensional evaluation protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G-CARL consistently outperforms existing post-training baselines in overall quality, claim-level precision, and checklist recall. Pairwise preference evaluation by clinicians further confirms that G-CARL produces interpretations that are more accurate and better aligned with patient needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了患者导向的医学报告解读任务(PMRI)及G-CARL强化学习框架。G-CARL通过检索增强的原子声明验证实现事实性监督,结合病例特定的加权检查清单实现需求满足与表达质量监督,无需约束响应多样性。同时构建了真实世界基准MMedReport,实验表明G-CARL在多项指标上优于现有后训练基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学视觉-语言任务未能充分捕捉"循证医学事实性"与"上下文依赖的患者沟通"这两大双重需求。传统监督微调易过拟合参考答案措辞,整体性强化学习的单一奖励信号无法区分目标特异性错误,且静态评估标准对病例关键信息的遗漏不敏感,导致患者被错误解读或不适当建议误导。
AI.method: 基于GRPO的G-CARL框架包含三类奖励:(1)检索增强的事实性奖励R_fact——将回答分解为原子医学声明,从多源医学知识库(药品说明书、教科书、临床指南共约54,200条)检索证据,通过双二元验证(Supported/Relevant)计算有效声明的精确率与覆盖率,以调和均值作为奖励;(2)病例特定检查清单奖励R_check——由MLLM生成草稿、临床医生精炼的四级权重(Essential/Important/Optional/Pitfall)清单,逐项独立评估正负覆盖;(3)结构化推理格式奖励R_format——鼓励四步临床推理脚手架。三者加权求和构成多目标优化函数。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B上,G-CARL将整体主观分从基线1.626提升至1.829,声明级精确率从93.46%提升至96.62%,检查清单召回率从60.68%提升至72.18%。在四种不同骨干模型(Qwen3-VL-4B/8B、InternVL3-8B/14B)上一致优于SFT和MLLM-as-a-Judge基线。在CMB外部基准上也实现QA准确率和专业性提升。消融实验验证了三类奖励的互补性,且检索增强与动态清单均优于其简化版本。在DPO、PROMETHEUS、RAR、MedRepBench、CapRL、FactScore等RL方法对比中取得最佳综合性能,临床医生偏好评估以136:85和106:64的优势胜出。
AI.conclusion: G-CARL通过将奖励监督按目标的可验证性边界分解,有效解决了医学事实性与患者沟通质量的联合优化难题,显著提升了PMRI任务的事实准确性、需求满足度与表达质量,为构建更可靠、以患者为中心的多模态医学助手奠定了基础。

title: The Lazy Pod That Lies: Deferred Cost and Failure Semantics of Lazy Container Image Pulling for Model Serving on Kubernetes
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Measurement artifact: this https URL
summary: Lazy container-image pulling promises to eliminate the dominant cost of starting a model-serving pod by mounting the image immediately and fetching content on demand. We evaluate this promise for model delivery on Kubernetes, using KServe with two production lazy-pulling systems -- eStargz/stargz-snapshotter and AWS SOCI -- against eager baselines, on artifacts from 2 to 140 GB including real fp16 weights. Lazy pulling delivers its headline: cold time-to-first-prediction becomes size-independent (16.9--17.6s, versus 24.5--573.0s eager). But the cost is deferred, not eliminated: a full read of a 14 GB model through the lazy mount takes 105.3s, slower than the 72.4s eager pull it replaced, and the two systems pay at opposite lifecycle ends (SOCI prefetches nearly the full image before Ready; eStargz defers nearly everything to first read). More consequentially, we characterize a failure mode eager pulling structurally cannot exhibit: under sustained legitimate reads with default configuration, the snapshotter's node-level cache exhausts its finite volume and already-running pods begin failing reads of model files. At the earliest stage of exhaustion, an instrumented serving pod passed every Kubernetes-visible and application-level check for 196s while its snapshotter was already logging real failures; under heavier pressure, 67--94% of model files fail, scaling monotonically with residual cache occupancy. A live pod self-heals if cache space is freed under it, but a snapshotter-daemon restart under a live pod leaves permanently stale file handles in a pod still reported Running. We derive placement, monitoring, and cache-sizing guidance for serving platforms and operators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了在Kubernetes上为模型服务（KServe）使用惰性容器镜像拉取（lazy pulling）的成本、收益与风险。研究对比了两种生产级惰性拉取系统（eStargz/stargz-snapshotter与AWS SOCI）与急切拉取（eager）基线在2–140 GB工件上的表现。核心发现包括：冷启动时间与镜像大小无关（16.9–17.6s），但首读延迟更高（14 GB时105.3s对比eager的72.4s）；揭示了一种新的失效模式——节点级缓存耗尽导致运行中Pod的读操作失败，但所有Kubernetes与应用层健康检查仍显示正常（"lying pod"）；并给出缓存规划、监控与运维建议。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习模型从MB级增长到百GB级，模型权重传输已成为Pod冷启动的主导开销，严重影响自动扩缩容与scale-to-zero的经济性。惰性镜像拉取被广泛部署以消除该开销，但其延迟成本的去向、新引入的失效语义、以及对运行中Pod的影响尚未被受控量化——而这些正是运维者在生产环境中启用惰性拉取前必须回答的关键问题。
AI.method: 在两台AWS i4i.2xlarge主机（独立网络与NVMe）上搭建单节点kind集群，部署KServe与containerd（启用ImageVolume）。对比eager基线（1层/8层gzip、8层zstd、对象存储）与惰性方案（eStargz v0.18.2、SOCI v0.15.0）。工件包括2/14/140 GB合成的不可压缩填充数据（模拟fp16权重统计特性）以及真实Mistral-7B fp16权重。引入两阶段测量活动C1（性能）与C2（失效特征化，后者使用真实NVMe分区作为有限缓存）。每次冷启动前强制清空缓存并通过per-rep NIC字节计数器验证冷态。所有失效实验配备数据通路耦合的预测器（读取固定3/280文件集并返回SHA-256片段），按节点级缓存占用率阶梯式测量失效比例与恢复行为。
AI.result: 1) 冷启动TTFP：eager随大小线性增长（2 GB:24.5s→140 GB:573.0s），eStargz保持16.9–17.6s恒定（≈33×加速），TTFP预算集中在container-start→Ready阶段；2) 延迟成本：14 GB全量读耗时105.3s（慢于72.4s eager），稳态吞吐≈143 MB/s（远低于518 MB/s的直连HTTP），存在3.5×的FUSE挂载税；3) 架构差异：SOCI前置加载（Ready前已传输≈15.8 GB），eStargz后置到首读（Ready时接近零传输）；4) 失效特征：节点级blob-chunk缓存无内置容量限制（仅LRU条目与fd有界），ENOSPC发生在已Ready Pod的读路径；仪器化Pod在真实I/O错误出现后196s内仍通过所有K8s与应用层检查；缓存占用率0%→90%时，280文件中188→264（67–94%）损坏，单读耗时从358s降至49s；5) 恢复：释放节点缓存可使live mount自愈；但在live Pod下重启snapshotter守护进程会导致永久性ESTALE错误，Pod仍报1/1 Running。
AI.conclusion: 惰性镜像拉取兑现了大小无关冷启动的承诺，但该承诺是延迟而非折扣。在全读工作负载且超过数GB阈值时，首读成本高于eager；并且惰性架构在默认配置下引入了新的失效类别——Pod在合法负载下自我损坏数据通路而所有健康指示灯保持绿色。建议：按工作负载读取比例选择部署策略（适配器/分片模型适配惰性，全读推理慎选SOCI前载或保留eager多包策略）；按节点而非单镜像规划缓存容量并显式回收；将snapshotter的Prometheus端点与日志提升为一类服务信号；将snapshotter守护进程重启视为Pod消亡事件，除非使用挂载保留机制（如SOCI的FUSE manager）。架构真正的设计轴是"前载 vs 后置"，而非"惰性 vs 急切"。

title: When Do LLM Agents Help? Deadline-Aware Mixed-Criticality Task Scheduling at the Autonomous-Vehicle Edge
summary: Autonomous vehicles offload latency-sensitive perception tasks to nearby mobile edge computing (MEC) servers, where a missed safety-critical task is unsafe rather than merely degraded. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as adaptive, explainable schedulers, yet evidence of when they help is scarce. We study deadline-aware, mixed-criticality scheduling on heterogeneous MEC servers, where time-critical (TC) tasks must be protected at a controlled cost to best-effort traffic, and ask whether a multi-agent LLM control layer improves on a strong heuristic. We answer in two steps. First we build the heuristic: a windowed contract-net auction that orders each admission window time-critical-first by earliest deadline and places tasks by earliest-finish-time. Across 60 instances on three topologies and 15 baselines under an identical online constraint, it attains a TC completion rate of 0.902, above every baseline (Holm-corrected p < 0.001; best baseline 0.838) and at 0.87 of a CP-SAT upper bound. Second, we add the LLM control plane. A controlled decomposition traces the scheduler's advantage to two ordinary factors, the batching horizon and time-critical-first ordering; the auction, the per-window LLM policy, and online adaptation add nothing while the load is stationary, where the heuristic is already near-optimal. Under a mid-run surge of safety-critical tasks the picture changes, and the LLM control plane gains significantly over both the static heuristic and the bandit. LLM orchestration therefore earns its cost only when non-stationarity opens headroom a fixed policy cannot use. We report control-plane latency and rationale, and release all code and seeded instances.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动驾驶移动边缘计算（MEC）场景，研究多智能体大语言模型（LLM）控制层是否真正优于强启发式调度器。作者提出一种双层架构：确定性数据平面（窗口化合同网拍卖+TC-EDF+EFT放置）与LLM控制平面（broker、edge、monitor智能体）。实验表明，调度器优势主要来自批处理窗口与时间关键优先排序两个"普通因素"，而非拍卖协议或LLM；LLM智能体编排仅在负载非平稳（突发安全关键任务激增）时才带来微弱但统计显著的收益。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆将延迟敏感的感知任务卸载到MEC服务器，错过安全关键（TC）任务将带来安全隐患而非性能降级。LLM被广泛提议作为自适应、可解释的调度器，但其在边缘调度中的实际贡献缺乏严格证据。本文聚焦一个尚未被严谨回答的架构性问题：轻量级LLM控制层能否、以及在何种条件下能优于一个有竞争力的截止时间感知调度器？
AI.method:
1. 双层架构设计：因LLM推理延迟（秒级）无法置于每任务关键路径，故分离为确定性数据平面（每个准入窗口执行TC-EDF+EFT调度）与LLM控制平面（每窗口设置策略参数，每R个窗口由monitor智能体自适应调整）。
2. 数据平面：窗口化合同网（CNP）拍卖——broker按发布顺序分组任务（窗口大小W=40），按时间关键优先、截止时间最早优先（TC-EDF）排序，按最早完成时间（EFT）将任务分配给中标agent。
3. 控制平面：三类LLM智能体——edge agent设置本地出价策略，broker agent决定是否放弃无法完成的尽力而为任务，monitor agent（以UCB1 bandit为对照）每R个窗口调整策略参数。
4. 对照设计：15个基线（FCFS、EDF、LLF、PSO、GA、DDQN、HEFT、Sufferage等）通过统一在线事件驱动引擎运行，3种拓扑共60实例，并以CP-SAT离线最优解作为上限。
AI.result:
整体对比（60实例）：所提CNP调度器TC完成率TCR_TC=0.902±0.009，显著优于所有15个基线（Holm校正p<0.001，Cliff's δ从-0.57到-0.96），达到CP-SAT上界的0.874（最优性差距≤13%），加权吞吐量最高（274.9）。
控制变量分解：优势来自两个普通因素——批处理视野W（W=1时0.795→W=200时0.942）和TC优先排序（W=40下从0.851升至0.896，但NTC率从0.845降至0.731）；拍卖协议、UCB1 bandit与LLM控制平面在平稳负载下均无显著增益（CNP-bandit p=0.465）。
非平稳负载：当运行中突增40个紧截止安全任务时，LLM控制平面相对静态启发式获得小幅但显著的增益（CNP-LLM +0.005，p=0.004；HAS +0.006，p=0.005），而bandit无显著差异（p=0.571）；在服务器宕机场景下无显著优势。
控制平面成本：每200任务实例27次模型调用，平均延迟3.0s（中位2.8s，P95=4.3s），远高于数据平面窗口时间，确认其必须脱离任务关键路径。
AI.conclusion:
1. 强基线本身已接近最优：窗口化TC-EDF+EFT列表调度器即足以在平稳负载下复现完整方法的优势，拍卖与LLM均不贡献额外价值。
2. LLM编排的价值是条件性的：仅当非平稳性（如突发TC任务激增）为更优策略留出可恢复空间时，LLM控制平面才显著优于固定策略与UCB1 bandit；其增益虽真实但幅度有限（典型0.5~0.6个百分点）。
3. 实践建议：LLM调度层应基于工作负载的可变性来论证，而非默认采用；需配备陈旧策略回退机制以应对控制平面延迟。
4. 未来工作：更大模型与采样方差、随机信道与RSU/broker排队模型、物理车载测试平台验证。

title: Optimality and Trade-offs in Fast BFT SMR (Extended Version)
summary: Fast state-machine replication (SMR) protocols in the crash-fault setting have attracted significant interest in both academia and industry. This interest stems from their advantages over leader-based protocols, including low execution latency for non-conflicting commands, high throughput, improved availability, and increased fairness. While Fast SMR is well studied in the crash-fault setting, the Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) setting remains much less understood, with only a small number of existing Fast BFT SMR protocols. In this paper, we present tight upper and lower bounds on the replication factor required for Fast BFT SMR. We also present a suboptimal protocol that illustrates a trade-off between replication factor and recovery efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Fast BFT状态机复制（SMR）的最优复制因子问题，证明了Fast BFT SMR需要n ≥ 5f+1个副本（紧界），并提出了一种新的协作式恢复机制使协议能同时达到最优弹性与最优执行延迟（2Δ）；同时给出了一个n ≥ 7f+1的次优协议，揭示了复制因子与恢复效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 无主（leaderless）Fast SMR在崩溃容错（CFT）场景下已被广泛研究（如EPaxos、Atlas、Accord等），具有低延迟、高吞吐、高可用和公平性等优势。但拜占庭容错（BFT）场景下的Fast SMR研究不足，先前将Fast SMR技术适配到BFT的尝试甚至被发现存在正确性问题。这篇论文旨在系统性地研究Fast BFT SMR：明确其必要的复制因子、能否保留Fast SMR的优势、维持安全性需要哪些新机制。
AI.method: 论文采用理论与协议设计相结合的方法：(1) 上界：设计n ≥ 5f+1的Fast BFT SMR协议（Algorithm 2），包含快速路径（fast path，需n-f个匹配FastVote即可提交）和恢复路径（recovery path，含状态/验证/提案/投票四阶段）。关键技术是协作式恢复：通过固定实例ID的全局序，恢复时只能向下等待低秩实例，并通过验证阶段识别可能已通过快路径提交的值，从而避免安全违反（保持Visibility不变量）。 (2) 下界：使用不可区分性论证（indistinguishability argument），将n个副本分为A、B、C、D、E五个不相交集合（每组≤f），构造5个执行σ₁~σ₅，通过副本视图的局部不可区分性推导出矛盾，证明n ≤ 5f时不存在Fast BFT SMR协议。(3) 次优协议：当n ≥ 7f+1时，n-3f大小的法定集合之间必有交集，恢复路径可省略验证阶段，变得简单高效。
AI.result: 主要结果包括三点：(1) 上界：n ≥ 5f+1的Fast BFT SMR协议（Algorithm 2）可实现最优执行延迟（冲突自由命令在同步期间于2Δ内执行），无需无故障快路径假设，也无需紧密同步时钟。(2) 紧下界（Theorem 7）：任何确定性Fast BFT SMR协议都要求n ≥ 5f+1，从而证明上述上界是紧的。(3) 次优协议（Algorithm 4）：n ≥ 7f+1时无需验证阶段，恢复路径更简单（视图计时器从6Δ缩短为4Δ），揭示了复制因子与恢复效率之间的权衡——更大的复制因子换取更简单高效的恢复过程。
AI.conclusion: 本文缩小了BFT与CFT场景下leaderless SMR理论理解之间的差距，确立了Fast BFT SMR复制因子的紧界（n=5f+1），并通过n ≥ 7f+1的次优协议阐明了复制成本与恢复效率之间的基本权衡。这一结果对实际系统设计具有指导意义：在冲突率低的工作负载下，Fast BFT SMR可在最优弹性下获得低延迟优势；当恢复开销成为吞吐瓶颈时，可通过增加副本数换取更高效的恢复路径。

title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
summary: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3-70B in fp8 across 60 H100 GPUs, CacheRoute sustains 176+/-11 QPS at a 3.5-s p99 SLO, 2.3x the strongest of five baselines. Served KV-cache hit rate rises from 64.1+/-1.3% under cache-blind balancing to 93.2+/-0.5%. A second semi-synthetic aggregate and controlled 8B and burst experiments separate the effects of affinity and placement. Two 32B workloads provide the counterexamples: when affinity recovers too little KV work, its residual load skew reduces or erases the improvement. We therefore recommend gating any deployment with a shadow replay rather than enabling affinity from workload statistics alone.

AI.tldr: CacheRoute 是一种面向大规模 LLM 服务的"计划式前缀亲和性"路由器，通过周期性构建路由表来同时优化 KV 缓存命中率和负载均衡，在 Llama-3.3-70B fp8 + 60 张 H100 上将 SLO 容量提升至最强基线的 2.3 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务引擎普遍支持前缀 KV 缓存以避免重复 prefill，但缓存无法控制请求路由位置。盲目负载均衡会分散重复请求，固定亲和性又会将 key 偏斜直接映射到服务器队列上。多租户对话助手场景（如客服聊天机器人）存在稳定的、跨会话可复用的业务上下文，请求速率在业务间差异巨大，需要在保持前缀局部性的同时避免单点队列成为整集群 p99 瓶颈。
AI.method: CacheRoute 将路由分为离线的周期规划与在线的快速派发两部分：1）规划阶段根据各 key 的估计速率 λ_b，按 k_b = max(1, ⌈λ_b/q_cap⌉) 计算每个 key 所需的副本数；2）按速率降序进行 top-rate 接纳，控制总接纳量不超过 C = R·W 个槽位；3）采用经典 LPT（最长处理时间优先）列表调度，将每个 key 的 k_b 个作业放入当前期望负载最小的不同目的地；4）接纳流量在固定的目的地子集 T(b) 中选最闲成员派发，未接纳流量回退到 power-of-two-choices。控制间隔内路由表保持不变以优先保证缓存稳定性。规划复杂度为 O(|B|log|B| + Σk_b log R)，可离线运行。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.3-70B fp8 / 30 个 TP2 目的地（60 张 H100）的主实验中，CacheRoute 在 p99 ≤ 3.5s SLO 下达到 176±11 QPS，是最强基线 Preble（76±11 QPS）的 2.3 倍、Flat-LB（42±20 QPS）的 4.2 倍；服务态 KV 缓存命中率从 64.1±1.3% 提升到 93.2±0.5%。8B 消融实验表明亲和性将 KV 命中率从 56% 提升到 88% 但带来 3.46× 负载不均，需配合 LPT 调度将不均降至 1.24× 才能将 SLO 容量从 240 提升至 ≥500 QPS。但两个 32B 工作负载出现反例：当亲和性恢复的 KV 工作量过小时，残余负载偏斜会降低或抹平收益（容量仅为 Flat-LB 的 0.50–0.67× 或与之持平）。此外，简单的解析常驻预测模型在 70B fp8 上偏差达 14.3–44.7 个百分点，因此推荐使用影子重放作为部署前的把关手段。
AI.conclusion: CacheRoute 通过周期性、基于速率的计划式路由同时兼顾前缀局部性与负载均衡，在大型 70B fp8 部署上实现显著的容量提升。但亲和性并非普适：当可恢复的前缀工作量过小时，其残余负载偏斜可能反而损害性能。因此任何实际部署都应通过影子重放实测边界后再启用，而非仅凭工作负载统计推断。前缀大小异构、长上下文、cache 逐出与接纳流量的交互等问题仍有待后续工作解决。

title: ParaWeb: Parallel Programming Patterns for Web Development
comment: Presented at HLPP 2026, 19th International Symposium on High-Level Parallel Programming and Applications, Paris, July 2026. Part of the HLPP 2026 proceedings (hal-05689350, arXiv:2607.12917 )
summary: Modern web applications increasingly require computationally intensive processing, yet JavaScript, the dominant language of the web, has traditionally been limited to a single-threaded execution model. this http URL Worker Threads and browser Web Workers provide low-level mechanisms for parallel execution, but developers lack high-level abstractions that capture recurring parallel structures as reusable patterns. In this paper, we present ParaWeb, a TypeScript library that implements ten parallel programming patterns for server-side this http URL , client-side browser environments, and WebGPU compute shaders. ParaWeb provides three implementation variants for each pattern: a message-passing (MP) variant based on structured cloning via postMessage, a shared-buffer (Shared) variant that uses SharedArrayBuffer with typed array views, and a GPU variant that uses WebGPU compute shaders for hardware-accelerated execution. We describe the architecture, design decisions, and pattern-specific implementation strategies, and we evaluate the performance of all thirty implementations across three data sizes. Experimental evaluation results show that the CPU-based variants achieve speedups of up to 11.6x with 16 threads for compute-bound patterns, while the GPU variants reach speedups of up to 260x for compute-bound patterns with high arithmetic intensity such as Farm, Scatter, Reduce, and Map. A case study on five image-convolution filters further shows that GPU acceleration reaches up to 414x speedup over single-threaded CPU on non-separable kernels, with consistent scaling across 1024x1024$, 2048x2048$, and 4K images.

AI.tldr: ParaWeb 是一个 TypeScript 库，为 Web 开发（Node.js、浏览器、WebGPU）实现了 10 种并行编程模式（Map、Filter、Reduce、Scan、Scatter、Stencil、Farm、Pipeline、Divide-and-Conquer、MapReduce），每种模式提供消息传递（MP）、共享缓冲区（Shared）和 GPU 三种实现变体。实验结果表明 CPU 变体在 16 线程下对计算密集型模式可达 11.6 倍加速，GPU 变体对高算术强度的 Farm/Scatter/Reduce/Map 模式可达 260 倍加速；图像卷积案例研究中 GPU 在非可分卷积核上可达 414 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现代 Web 应用越来越多地处理计算密集型任务（如图像处理、实时分析、ML 推理），但 JavaScript 传统上是单线程模型。虽然 Node.js Worker Threads 和浏览器 Web Workers 提供了底层并行机制，但开发者缺乏捕获常见并行结构的高层抽象。C++ 生态中的 SkePU、FastFlow、GrPPI 等模式化并行框架已被证明能提高程序员生产力，但 JavaScript 生态中尚无覆盖 Worker Threads、Web Workers 和 WebGPU 的模式化并行库。早期的 River Trail 项目因需要引擎级修改而被放弃。
AI.method: ParaWeb 采用模块化架构，每个模式作为独立类实现，共享统一的类型化 API 和工作线程池基础设施。三种实现变体的设计权衡为：(1) MP 变体通过 postMessage 和结构化克隆传递数据，简单通用但有序列化开销；(2) Shared 变体使用 SharedArrayBuffer 与 Float64Array 视图实现零拷贝数据共享，但需要跨源隔离头并限制为类型化数组；(3) GPU 变体通过 WebGPU 计算着色器（WGSL）卸载计算，支持 f32 精度。Worker 池按脚本路径和池大小懒创建并缓存以摊销创建开销。函数通过 Function.toString() 序列化为字符串后在 worker 中用 new Function() 重建。GPU 数据并行模式采用每元素一线程（workgroup 大小 256），Reduce 使用分层归约，Filter 使用三阶段流压缩（标记-前缀和-压缩），任务并行模式委托给 Map 内核。模式分为三类：数据并行（Map/Filter/Reduce/Scan/Scatter）、任务并行（Farm/Pipeline/D&C）、专用模式（Stencil/MapReduce）。设计灵感主要来自 GrPPI 框架。
AI.result: 在 Apple M3 Max（16 核 CPU、40 核 GPU、48GB 统一内存）上实验评估了所有 30 种实现。Node.js CPU 加速：Map 10.48x、Filter 10.44x、Scatter 11.54x、Reduce 11.62x、Scan 9.88x、Farm 11.25x（MP）/9.99x（Shared）、Pipeline 8.69x、Stencil 6.52x、MapReduce 9.93x、D&C 2.73x（FFT 受限于跨阶段同步）。Shared 变体在大多数计算密集型模式上优于 MP。浏览器（headless Chromium）结果与 Node.js 排名一致，Farm Shared 达 11.85x。GPU 结果（vs 顺序基线）：Farm 260.5x、Scatter 239.6x、Reduce 94.2x、Scan 67.0x、Map 63.5x、MapReduce 53.7x、Pipeline 25.7x、Stencil 17.7x；Filter 因 GPU 三阶段压缩中单工作组前缀和成为瓶颈而逊于 CPU。Reduce 和 Scan 在纯结合操作下因内存带宽限制并行加速为负，但融合逐元素三角变换后可达 9x 以上。图像卷积案例研究：5 种滤波器（高斯模糊、盒式模糊、锐化、浮雕、DoG 边缘检测）在 1024²、2048² 和 4K 图像上一致缩放；可分滤波器 GPU 加速 5x→40-50x（半径 1→20），非可分浮雕滤波器 GPU 在半径 20 时达 414x（75ms vs 31s 顺序），DoG 边缘检测达 85x。变体选择具有工作负载依赖性，静态默认（CPU 用 Shared，计算密集模式推荐 GPU）是有用的起点。
AI.conclusion: ParaWeb 证明了一个统一的类型化 API 可以同时支持 Node.js Worker Threads、浏览器 Web Workers 和 WebGPU 计算着色器三种执行环境下的并行编程模式，无需引擎级修改。其设计填补了 JavaScript 生态中模式化并行编程库的空白，使计算密集型 Web 应用能从批处理式延迟转变为真正交互式的客户端体验，同时保护数据隐私。主要局限性包括：浏览器 Shared 变体需要跨源隔离、GPU 为 f32 精度、GPU Filter 压缩步骤中的单工作组前缀和瓶颈、用户函数必须自包含（因 new Function() 不保留词法作用域）、变体选择为静态。未来工作方向：动态运行时变体选择、组合模式的融合 GPU 内核、CPU 与 GPU 异构协同工作分配、以及感知云端连续统一性的调度器（根据输入大小、网络条件和数据驻留约束决定在客户端执行、卸载到服务器或拆分执行）。

title: Design and Empirical Evaluation of a Network-Centric, On-Premises Architecture for Earth Observation Data Access
summary: Earth observation (EO) programmes generate data at volumes that exceed the transfer and storage capacity of most institutional networks. Public cloud platforms address this for well-resourced organisations, but institutions across the Atlantic basin face constraints in connectivity, sovereignty and funding that make on-premises infrastructure the only viable path. Cloud-native data formats enable efficient partial reads, yet their performance depends on the bandwidth of the underlying network fabric, a dependency rarely measured in isolation. This paper presents a replicable, network-centric architecture for on-premises EO data access, evaluated at its first operational deployment: the AIR Data Centre, founding node of the Atlantic Cloud. The system comprises a MinIO object storage cluster on a 100 GbE fabric, a PostGIS metadata catalogue and an OGC API-EDR access layer. We characterise the fabric under sustained parallel load, evaluate object storage throughput for EO-representative workloads, and compare measured performance against throttled baselines on identical hardware, isolating network bandwidth as the sole variable. Multi-site replication benchmarks with partner institutions characterise the federation primitive the model depends on. Network bandwidth is the dominant constraint on storage throughput for bulk EO data access up to a threshold; beyond it, endpoint memory topology rather than capacity governs how much bandwidth a system can use. For this hardware class that threshold lies above 10 Gbps per server. Below it, network capacity alone sets what the facility can deliver; above it, the return on further network investment depends on endpoint memory provisioning, which can be deferred and bought later.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种以网络为中心的、可复制的本地部署地球观测（EO）数据访问架构，并在其首个运营部署——AIR数据中心（大西洋云的创始节点）上进行了评估。系统包括100 GbE网络上的MinIO对象存储集群、PostGIS元数据目录和OGC API-EDR访问层。研究表明，网络带宽是大规模EO数据访问的主要制约因素，超过10 Gbps后则由终端内存拓扑决定。
AI.motivation: 随着地球观测项目产生的数据量超过大多数机构网络的传输和存储能力，公共云平台虽适合资源充足的机构，但大西洋沿岸的机构受限于连接性、主权和资金，本地基础设施是唯一可行路径。云原生数据格式的性能依赖于底层网络带宽，这一依赖很少被单独测量，因此需要一种网络中心的架构来填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 该论文设计和部署了一种网络中心的本地EO数据访问架构，包括三个核心组件：基于100 GbE网络的MinIO对象存储集群、PostGIS元数据目录和OGC API-EDR访问层。评估方法包括：1）在持续并行负载下表征网络性能；2）评估对象存储对EO代表性工作负载的吞吐量；3）在相同硬件上与节流基线进行对比，仅隔离网络带宽作为变量；4）进行多站点复制基准测试以表征联邦原语。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）网络带宽是大规模EO数据访问存储吞吐量的主要限制因素，直至达到阈值；2）超过该阈值后，终端内存拓扑（而非容量）决定系统能使用的带宽量；3）对于该硬件类别，阈值高于每服务器10 Gbps；4）低于阈值时，网络能力单独决定设施性能；5）高于阈值时，进一步网络投资的回报取决于终端内存配置，可以延后购买。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为资源受限机构提供了一种可复制的网络中心架构方案，证明了本地基础设施能够有效处理EO数据访问需求。核心结论是网络带宽在10 Gbps以下时是绝对限制，超过后内存拓扑成为关键因素，这为机构投资决策提供了明确指导——可以先投资网络，后续按需扩展内存。

title: FleetSieve: Decision-Critical Profiling for SLO-Aware LLM Fleet Configuration
summary: Choosing tensor-parallel (TP) degrees and replica counts for an LLM serving fleet is difficult because performance is not monotonic in TP and the feasible choice can change with load. Exhaustive profiling resolves this uncertainty, but measures many configurations that do not affect the final resource allocation. We present FleetSieve, which selects measurements according to their expected effect on a resource-coupled, SLO-aware fleet decision. FleetSieve models capacity and tail latency jointly, compares conservative and optimistic allocations, and stops when their remaining decision gap is below a specified tolerance. On a fixed H100 measurement grid for a 31B-parameter open-weight model, FleetSieve reaches the oracle aggregate decision using 22,200 GPU-seconds, 6.9% less than uniform random profiling in the fixed comparison. Across 200 random reveal orders, its mean saving over random profiling is 5.4% (95% bootstrap CI: 3.5-7.2%). The fixed-comparison saving is 21.5% for Chat, while FleetSieve does not use the fewest GPU-seconds for Code. Joint capacity and tail modeling also avoids selecting a configuration whose 46.4-second completion p99 violates a 30-second SLO. In a 16-GPU allocation, an incorrect sparse-profile decision loses up to 1.93 requests/s and 12.4 percentage points of max-min fulfillment. Boundary repeats and BurstGPT measurements support the observed load-dependent tail-latency mechanism.

AI.tldr: FleetSieve是一种面向LLM服务集群的"决策关键型"剖析框架，通过联合建模容量与尾部延迟、比较保守与乐观资源分配来筛选必要测量。在31B模型与H100平台的评估中，FleetSieve在聚合层面比随机剖析节省约6.9%的GPU秒，并对Chat工作负载节省21.5%，但对Code无改进。
AI.motivation: LLM服务集群中，TP度与副本数的选择具有非单调性，且最优配置随负载变化；穷举剖析虽可靠但测量了大量对最终资源分配无影响的配置。现有主动学习、贝叶斯优化等方法多针对预测不确定性或单一最优配置，无法直接服务于资源耦合的集群分配决策。需要一种直接以"是否影响下游分配"为准则的剖析方法。
AI.method: FleetSieve将剖析建模为下游决策识别问题：(1)基于内部膝点结构先验与测量残差，维护每个配置的容量区间与尾部延迟区间；(2)在每个轮次中分别求解保守分配（下界容量+上界尾部）与乐观分配（上界容量+下界尾部）；(3)定义三态决策证书（Certified-Feasible / Undecided / Certified-Infeasible），当临界可行性已解决且保守-乐观分配差距低于容忍度ε=0.05时停止；(4)采集函数以测量对分配差距缩减的预期贡献为评分，而非孤立不确定性。问题被形式化为带优先级、关键类满足下限与词典序目标（临界满足→最大化最小满足率→最大化总服务吞吐→最小化碎片化）的整数资源耦合分配。
AI.result: 在H100固定测量网格（21个标准单元+4个TP2校准单元）上评估31B开源模型：(1)聚合层面FleetSieve使用22,200 GPU秒，比随机剖析少6.9%、比其他基线少9.8–21.3%；200次随机揭示顺序下均值节省5.4%（95% CI 3.5–7.2%）；(2)Chat节省21.5%，Code未取得最优；(3)联合建模避免了completion p99达46.4秒而违反30秒SLO的配置被误选；(4)16-GPU集群中，错误的稀疏剖析决策在1.3×需求下损失最多1.93 req/s与12.4百分点的max-min满足率；(5)峰值可行吞吐在TP4处取得拐点（Chat 1.649、Code 2.779 req/s/GPU），且C128负载下TP4尾部违规而TP8可行，验证了负载依赖机制。
AI.conclusion: FleetSieve证明了以"对下游资源耦合分配的影响"作为剖析采集准则的可行性，能在不确定性仍能改变分配时减少测量开销。但其收益具有工作负载依赖性与校准依赖性——当关键拐点早期即可判定（如Code）时优势消失。证书为经验校准而非无条件正确性保证，且评估限于单一模型、单一平台与单一服务栈，需在多模型与多硬件上进一步验证泛化性。

title: The Evaluation Context Protocol (ECP): A Portable Contract for AI Agent Evaluation
comment: 14 pages, 4 tables, 4 figures, Code available at this https URL
summary: The evolution of artificial intelligence has necessitated a fundamental shift from evaluating isolated Large Language Models (LLMs) to assessing autonomous agentic architectures. This paper explores the critical methodologies for evaluating AI agents and the essential role of advanced observability infrastructure. We analyze the architectural components of agents and identify the severe limitations of current evaluation paradigms, including benchmark exploitation, the "confidently wrong" phenomenon, and the discrepancy between theoretical capability and operational reliability. To begin addressing the fragmentation in current evaluation infrastructure, this paper proposes the Evaluation Context Protocol (ECP), an early-stage, vendor-neutral framework intended to act as a portable evaluation contract layer for agentic systems. In its current form ECP defines a small JSON-RPC interface over which an agent exposes its user-visible output, the tool calls it made, and evaluator-safe audit context, and against which programmatic checks can be run uniformly across frameworks and continuous integration systems. We describe an open-source reference implementation that includes adapters for LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, and PydanticAI, and we situate the design against failure modes documented in the recent literature. ECP is presented as work in progress rather than a finished standard: the evaluation surface, method set, and grader families are all expected to change as the protocol is exercised against more systems, and the empirical validation required to justify adoption is outlined as future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估上下文协议(ECP),一个面向AI智能体系统的早期、厂商中立的可移植评估契约层。ECP基于JSON-RPC 2.0定义了一个小型接口,允许智能体暴露用户可见输出、工具调用及评估者安全的审计上下文,并通过manifest.yaml和统一评分器在LangChain、LlamaIndex、CrewAI、PydanticAI等不同框架及CI流水线中执行一致的程序化检查。作者明确将其定位为正在进行中的工作而非已成型标准,后续需通过故障注入、可移植性和开销三类实证研究来验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前自主AI智能体(执行SQL、修改数据库、调用金融API等)的可靠性面临严峻挑战,但评估体系存在结构性缺陷:静态基准无法捕捉轨迹可靠性,LLM-as-a-Judge存在位置偏置、冗长偏置和自我偏好偏置,pass@k指标严重高估生产可靠性(如pass@3=97%时pass^3可能仅34%)。此外,评估基础设施与LangChain、LlamaIndex、CrewAI、AutoGen等特定编排框架深度耦合,造成厂商锁定和科学可复现性下降。MCP解决了工具执行的标准化,但评估契约层仍然缺失。
AI.method: ECP的技术核心是JSON-RPC 2.0契约,默认采用stdio传输(也支持Streamable HTTP)。当前方法集仅包含agent/initialize、agent/step、agent/reset三个核心方法,刻意保持精简以利于独立重新实现。结果包络(envelope)暴露三个可独立评分的字段:public_output(用户可见输出)、tool_calls(工具调用轨迹,含名称和参数)及evaluation_context(评估者安全的审计证据,故意区别于原始思维链以保护商业秘密),外加一个可选的logs字段。内置三种评分器:text_match(contains/equals/regex等)、llm_judge(经校准的rubric)和tool_usage(名称匹配+参数子集匹配)。参考实现通过适配器模式包装四种主流框架:LangChain通过回调处理器注入、LlamaIndex桥接异步模型、CrewAI包装kickoff、PydanticAI提取结构化消息历史。评估由manifest.yaml(JSON Schema验证)驱动,执行ecp run命令即可在CI中作为构建门禁运行,失败时返回非零退出码。系统附带趋势分析、pytest插件及实验性的外部追踪平台导出路径。
AI.result: 当前ECP已交付工作协议定义、Python参考运行时和SDK、初步的TypeScript SDK、四个框架适配器、conformance harness、已发布的JSON Schema及可运行示例。但作者明确指出尚不存在:证明协议相对仅结果评估能改善缺陷检测的证据、独立实现间互操作的证据、作者自身测试之外的大规模部署。本文援引MAESTRO在12个MAS框架上的研究证实架构本身是性能的主导驱动因素;MOYA在CloudOps环境中的部署发现基于结果的指标掩盖了大量策略偏离;AIDev数据集显示AI智能体拉取请求虽然干预频次低(52.17% vs 83.59%)但审查工作量大得多;医疗保健范围综述(43项研究)表明现有评估过度依赖模拟环境,缺乏真实临床试验及安全性终点指标。文章未报告ECP自身的控制实验结果。
AI.conclusion: ECP提出了一条可行路径,通过将评估契约与执行平台解耦,使行为检查能够直接嵌入CI流水线并跨框架移植,但其评估表面由当前实现倒推于已记录的失败模式而非源自智能体行为的成熟理论。未来工作按四个阶段推进:Rigor阶段(原生重复执行并报告pass@k与pass^k、引入方差度量、为tool_calls添加result/latency/cost字段、声明式policy_check与沙箱化code_exec评分器);Trust阶段(厂商中立judge适配器、机器可检查的judge校准记录、签名报告、内容寻址清单来源、密封保留清单);Ecosystem阶段(委派与交接语义、evaluation_context的结构化schema、正式化人机协同暂停点、通用可观测性导出、TypeScript SDK成熟);Stability阶段(版本控制与弃用策略、冻结规范、至少两个独立实现通过同一合规配置、监管领域清单模板、发布经验性验证)。ECP明确声明不作为可观测性后端、基准或编排框架,且不会强制披露原始思维链——评估者安全证据的边界正是为闭源模型厂商保留参与动机。

title: Stable Within, Unidentified Across: Semantic Identification of Benchmark Effects and Rankings
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Includes an ancillary reproducibility archive
summary: Evaluation conclusions depend on evaluator-controlled semantics: legal references, scoreability, and aggregation. We call an artifact-defined endpoint Q(s) evaluation-semantically identified when it is invariant over a declared family. A frozen 217-row analysis appears stable within its restricted contract family. In TraceElephant, F_asym yields precise task-disjoint adoption effects from -40.76 to -43.03 percentage points, whereas both jointly frozen contrast-comparable treatments in F_cc yield exactly zero with [0, 0] intervals. Their union F_audit therefore does not identify T, even though F_cc identifies T = 0. A factorial audit attributes 100 percent of the disagreement to one-sided terminal deletion, with zero nonterminal contribution. Rankings remain specification-dependent across the symmetric treatments. This is a localized non-implication witness and reusable family-indexed audit, not a prevalence estimate, exhaustive semantic taxonomy, or independent replication.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"评价语义识别"(evaluation semantic identification)概念,揭示基准测试结论在受限语义族内稳健,并不意味着跨语义族可识别。通过 TraceElephant 的 217 行轨迹分析,证明单侧末端删除使 F_asym 族产生 -40.76 至 -43.03pp 的精确负面效应,而 F_cc 对称族精确为零,联合族 F_audit 不可识别效应;排名在 F_cc 内亦不可识别。这是一个定位化的非蕴涵见证,不是普遍性估计。
AI.motivation: 基准测试结论常被描述为"稳健",但其依赖于评估者控制的语义操作(合法参考、可评分性、聚合)。论文区分两类问题:在固定契约下异质实现是否一致(轨迹→评分对象),以及在固定工件与预测下效应与排名是否跨语义不变(评估者→结论)。前者是评分对象的识别,后者是结论的识别——该论文聚焦后者,明确指出"族内稳健"不等价于"跨语义识别"。
AI.method: 1) 形式化评价语义映射 M_s:从固定工件 x_i 与冻结预测 p_im 经语义映射、行评分 ℓ_s、聚合 A_s 得到端点 Q(s);2) 定义有限经验识别集 I_Q(F)={Q(s):s∈F},点识别要求|I_Q(F)|=1;3) 声明三个语义族:F_asym(单侧末端)、F_cc(对称末端)、F_audit(联合);4) 设计审计可采纳性准则(程序可采纳+实质活性,六条要求,结果无关语义替代须联合冻结并全部报告);5) 在 TraceElephant 217 行数据上,实施 V1 预测自由诊断门(暴露本体不兼容)、V2 条件非对称估计、两个对称对照(na_keep_both/na_exclude_both)及因子删除定位机制。
AI.result: F_asym 族下任务不相交效应精确为负,区间 -40.76 至 -43.03pp,均排除零;F_cc 族下 T(b)=0 对所有背景/政策/对称处理,|I_T(F_cc)|={0};联合族 |I_T(F_audit)|>1(非识别);排名在 F_cc 内 |I_R(F_cc)|>1(亦非识别);因子删除归因 100% 不一致源于单侧末端删除,非末端贡献为零;PageRank-Earliest 单行追溯:e0047/e0013 在 V2 下产生 (1,1)→(0,1) 的 -1 单元,而两种对称处理下严格为 0。
AI.conclusion: 识别是族相对的:F_cc 内 I_T={0} 但 F_audit 非识别;F_cc 内排名仍不可识别。结论只在其声明族内成立,单侧末端删除是定位化的机制见证。该论文贡献:1) 规格索引的评价语义识别形式化及三族区分;2) 结果无关的有限识别集与审计可采纳性准则;3) TraceElephant 上的完整定位实证见证;4) 可复用的族索引审计记录接口。它不是普遍性估计、详尽语义分类或独立复制,而是定位化的非蕴涵见证与可重用审计方法。

title: Hype Meets Reality: Large Language Models as Mutators in Search-based Automated Program Repair of Simulink-Stateflow Models
summary: Search-based Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques rely on carefully designed mutation operators to explore the space of candidate fixes. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest that generative models could replace such operators by dynamically proposing repairs. In this paper, we investigate this hypothesis in the context of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) modeled in Simulink/Stateflow. We extend the state-of-the-art FlowRepair approach by replacing a subset of its mutation operators with LLM-generated mutations, enabling more flexible and expressive patch generation. We evaluate the approach on a benchmark of 19 real-world faulty Stateflow models across four CPS domains, using the same experimental setup as FlowRepair for controlled comparison under the same wall-clock budget. Contrary to expectations, in this controlled evaluation, the LLM-based mutation substantially degrades repair performance under the FlowRepair experimental setup. Across the tested LLM variants, the LLM-based repair produced plausible patches for 4-6 models and valid patches for 4 models, compared to 18 and 16, respectively, with the original approach. Our analysis reveals that, in this integration, LLMs struggle with precise symbolic edits, lack behavioral feedback, and generate a noisy search space that hinders effective exploration. Rather than showing a general limitation of LLMs for APR, these findings highlight fundamental limitations of naively integrating LLMs into search-based APR and motivate hybrid approaches that combine structured mutation with generative guidance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了用大型语言模型（LLM）替代搜索式自动程序修复（APR）中传统手工设计的变异算子，在Simulink/Stateflow信息物理系统（CPS）模型上进行故障修复。基于FlowRepair框架，作者用LLM生成的变异替换了10个Stateflow专用的变异算子（保留了5个结构相关算子），并在19个真实故障模型的基准上评估了三种LLM变体（GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-4.1-mini）。结果显示，LLM变异策略大幅降低了修复性能：原始FlowRepair能对18/19模型生成合理补丁、16/19生成有效补丁，而LLM方案仅能在4-6个模型上生成合理补丁、4个模型上生成有效补丁。该研究是一个重要的负面结果，表明在CPS仿真修复这一特殊场景下，简单用生成式模型替代领域特定变异算子并非有效策略。
AI.motivation: 基于搜索的APR技术（如FlowRepair）依赖精心设计的变异算子来探索候选修复空间，但面临两难：变异算子过少则修复能力有限，过多则搜索空间过大且难以扩展，尤其在CPS等仿真昂贵的领域。LLM在通用代码修复中展现出的潜力引发了将其用作动态变异算子的设想：能否让LLM直接生成Stateflow模型的修复候选，从而取代或补充手工设计的算子？作者旨在通过受控实验验证这一假设。
AI.method: 方法上，作者将FlowRepair中的15个变异算子中的10个（涉及关系/条件/数学运算符替换、单位变更、数值替换、变量/条件删除、数学运算和变量/条件插入等表达式级操作）替换为基于LLM的通用变异算子，保留5个结构级算子（转换源/目标替换、初始转换、状态/转换删除）以处理结构性故障。精心设计了针对状态和转换的两种提示模板，包含组件类型、标识符、当前标签、可用变量列表、少样本示例以及严格的JSON输出格式约束。评估采用与原始FlowRepair完全相同的实验设置：19个故障模型、4个CPS领域（起搏器、冰箱、门、电梯）、1小时时间预算、每个模型5次独立运行、采用Tarantula故障定位，使用三种LLM变体（GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-4.1-mini，温度设为0.8），收集合理补丁和有效补丁数量作为指标。
AI.result: 结果与预期相反：在受控评估中，LLM变异大幅降低了FlowRepair的修复性能。FlowRepair原方法对18/19模型生成合理补丁、16/19模型生成有效补丁；而LLM方案中GPT-5.5仅对4/19模型同时生成合理与有效补丁，GPT-5.4-mini对6/19生成合理补丁、4/19生成有效补丁，GPT-4.1-mini对5/19生成合理补丁、4/19生成有效补丁。LLM在本地化语义变换（如简化复合条件、小幅算术修正）上有一定优势（典型例子如fridge_2a和elevator_8被三种LLM变体全部修复），但在需要精确值合成（如door_2需将1改为-1）、缺失表达式插入（elevator_1、elevator_2）、结构修改（door_1需修改转换源）以及组合编辑（fridge_2）时表现不佳。分析揭示了三个根本性局限：(1) LLM生成的变异使搜索空间变得嘈杂、约束松散，在每次仿真评估都昂贵的CPS场景下迅速耗尽预算；(2) LLM缺乏来自仿真的行为反馈，无法迭代优化建议；(3) LLM主要操作文本表示，对Stateflow的拓扑结构和执行语义理解有限。此外，fridge_2a的成功部分归因于其修复模式出现在少样本提示中，反映出提示条件下的生成而非真正的独立推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 该论文得出结论：在评估的CPS Stateflow修复配置下，简单地用LLM生成式变异替代FlowRepair手工设计的领域特定变异算子，并未提升反而显著降低了修复性能。作者强调这并非否定LLM在APR中的整体潜力，而是揭示了将LLM天真地整合到基于搜索的APR框架中所面临的根本性局限。基于此，作者主张未来的研究应转向混合架构，例如：(1) 将仿真反馈整合到提示循环中以引导LLM迭代优化；(2) 让LLM充当传统算子的顾问（排序、过滤、实例化）而非直接生成补丁；(3) 选择性地仅替换LLM具有明确优势的算子；(4) 在Stateflow特定语料上对LLM进行微调或继续预训练。该研究的负面结果对校准社区的预期具有重要价值，提醒研究者不能将LLM在通用代码修复中的成功直接迁移到仿真密集、专业化程度高且测试预言稀疏的领域。

title: RD-Gen: Random DAG Generator Considering Multi-rate Applications for Reproducible Scheduling Evaluation
summary: Real-time systems have various requirements such as the deadline and resource constraints. In addition, real-time systems are becoming larger and more complex, and studies on performance analysis and efficient scheduling algorithms are becoming increasingly important. Directed acyclic graph (DAG) models, which can express task dependencies and parallelism, are used for such studies. Random DAG sets are used to demonstrate the effectiveness and objectivity of methods proposed for real-time systems. However, there is no random DAG generation tool available that can generate a DAG set that considers the latest multi-rate applications. Therefore, researchers need to generate random DAG sets on their own, leading to additional effort and reduced reliability and reproducibility. To solve this problem, we propose a random DAG generator considering multi-rate applications for reproducible scheduling evaluation (RD-Gen). RD-Gen also enables batch generation of random DAG sets with different parameters. Case studies are used to demonstrate that RD-Gen can manage various problem settings and DAG study requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RD-Gen的开源随机DAG（有向无环图）生成工具，专门用于实时系统调度评估的可重复性研究。RD-Gen扩展了现有的Fan-in/Fan-out和G(n,p)方法，并新增了Chain-based方法以支持多速率（multi-rate）和链式（chain-based）DAG的生成，通过YAML配置文件实现一键批量生成可复现的随机DAG集。
AI.motivation: 实时系统（如自动驾驶）日益复杂，DAG模型被广泛用于任务调度与性能分析研究。现有随机DAG生成工具（TGFF于1999年提出、GGen于2010年提出）无法生成满足最新多速率应用需求的多速率DAG。研究人员不得不自行实现DAG生成器，导致评估结果的可靠性与可复现性降低，工作量增加。
AI.method: RD-Gen提供三种图构建方法：(1) 扩展的Fan-in/Fan-out方法，支持指定节点数、源/汇节点数，并保证弱连通性；(2) 扩展的G(n,p)方法，通过节点索引约束避免环并保证弱连通；(3) 新提出的Chain-based方法，通过主序列、子序列、垂直链接与合并机制生成链式多速率DAG。用户通过YAML文件配置参数，支持Fixed、Random、Combination三种规格。属性设置采用UUniFast方法自动分配利用率，支持基于总利用率（U）和通信计算比（CCR）等复合参数的自动配置。使用伪随机数生成器（seed机制）保证可复现性，输出支持YAML、JSON、XML、DOT等格式。
AI.result: 通过三个案例研究验证了RD-Gen的有效性：(1) 单速率DAG配合不同CCR值；(2) 多速率DAG配合不同总利用率（5%~95%，步长5%）；(3) 链式DAG配合不同总利用率（0.5~4.0）。与现有工具对比，RD-Gen仅需约20行YAML配置即可完成生成（零额外代码），而TGFF需51~138行代码，GGen需51~138行代码。RD-Gen是唯一同时支持单速率、多速率、链式DAG生成、基于总利用率的属性设置以及一键批量生成的工具。
AI.conclusion: RD-Gen成功填补了多速率DAG随机生成工具的空白，为DAG调度与延迟分析研究提供了灵活的可复现评估平台，显著降低了研究人员的工作量。未来工作将扩展更多图生成方法与更复杂的属性设置。

title: An Agentic RAG and Evaluation Framework for Assurance Case Generation: Industrial Use Case for the EU Cyber Resilience Act Compliance
summary: Complying with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) is a resource-intensive challenge for SMEs due to the complexity of cybersecurity conformity assessment. Yet, it is essential for demonstrating regulatory compliance and ensuring product security and resilience. To address this, we introduce an automated framework for generating Assurance Cases (ACs) using an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounded in a formal Claim-Argument-Evidence logic. By systematically mapping technical documentation requirements, the framework streamlines the generation of certification evidence. We validate our approach on a case study of Catalink's PATROLIoT wildfire monitoring system, where the agentic RAG generated 70 ACs with high grounding density (~4.4 artefacts per AC). The proposed Natural Language Inference (NLI) evaluator achieves 0.88 accuracy, which provides robust evidence grounding and traceability, while expert-validated plausibility (3.06) supports interpretable justifications. For practitioners, this work provides a scalable, interpretable approach for automating mandatory CRA conformity assessments, reducing manual effort while maintaining transparent decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于 Agentic RAG（智能体检索增强生成）的端到端框架，用于自动化生成符合欧盟《网络韧性法案》（CRA）的 Assurance Case（保证案例，AC）。该框架以 Claim-Argument-Evidence（CAE）形式构建 AC，每条论证均锚定在企业本地技术文档中；并结合多跳 NLI 评估器和领域专家可信度研究，在 Catalink 公司 PATROLIoT 野火监测系统上完成工业验证，生成 70 个 AC，引用覆盖率 86.2%，NLI 评估器准确率达 0.88。
AI.motivation: 1. 欧盟 CRA 要求制造商提供详尽的技术文档与合规证据，对缺乏合规专家的中小企业（SME）负担极重；2. 现有 AC 自动化方法多依赖 LLM 内部知识或预定义模板，难以在异构、碎片化的工业文档中实现深度可追溯的论证生成；3. 现有方法多依赖云端 LLM，带来专有文档的机密性风险；4. 在 CRA 等新兴监管领域，缺乏标注训练数据，且"LLM-as-a-judge"难以捕捉技术推理的语义细微差别；5. 亟需一种在工业现实约束下兼顾可生成性、可评估性与可解释性的端到端框架。
AI.method: 1. **Agentic RAG 生成阶段**：基于 LangChain 的 ReAct 方法构建智能体，输入 CRA 要求与产品上下文（JSON 格式），通过多轮迭代检索不断精炼查询，最终输出符合 CAE 层次结构的 JSON；2. **文档处理**：使用 Docling 摄取异构文档，按 3000 字符分块（重叠 500），通过 BGE-M3 嵌入存入 ChromaDB；提供语义搜索与文件名过滤两阶段检索工具；3. **NLI 评估器**：扩展前期多跳 NLI 框架，将 CAE 树边转换为 Entailment/Not-Entailment 推理对，提出"合成-到-真实"两阶段评估法（先在 D_syn 训练，后在 D_real 验证）；4. **专家可信度研究**：产品负责人在离线热力图界面上评估 60 个 NLI 实例，从五个维度（Justification、Necessity、Sufficiency、Trust、Agreement）以 5 点 Likert 量表打分；5. **模型配置**：Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 用于生成，Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 作为 LLM Judge，BERT-large 与 LLaMA-3.2-1B 分别用于微调与 ICL 对比；所有流程本地执行以保护机密性。
AI.result: 1. **RQ1（接地与可追溯性）**：在 70 个生成的 AC 中，356 个证据节点中 307 个含文档引用，引用覆盖率 86.2%，平均每个 AC 包含约 4.4 个引用工件；49 个无引用的节点可作为文档缺口诊断信号；2. **RQ2（推理泛化）**：BERT 在 w/o Chain 设置下基于 Agentic RAG 训练取得 0.88 准确率与 0.85 F1，显著优于 Vanilla-LLM 基线；细调 BERT 较 LLaMA-1B ICL 性能领先最高 35%；w/o Chain 优于 Chain 设置；3. **RQ3（解释可信度）**：人类专家评估中 BERT w/o Chain 取得均值 3.06 分及 50% 的技术一致率（Q5），优于 LLaMA 的 2.17 均值；LLM Judge 表现出明显的"可信度偏差"，对 LLaMA 解释过度评分，与人类判断出现显著背离（如 BERT Chain 协议率：人类 50% vs LLM Judge 11.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的 Agentic RAG 框架可有效解决 SME 在 CRA 合规中"无标注数据"的现实难题：(1) 自动化的文档检索与 AC 构建在异构工业文档中保留了来源可追溯性；(2) 基于智能体接地合成的数据可泛化至未见过的审计要求，弥补标注数据稀缺的缺口；(3) 可解释的 NLI 评估器通过 token 级热力图为工程师审查合规决策的技术依据提供支持。但需指出：框架保证论证的逻辑一致性而非法律意义上的合规性，最终合规判定仍需依赖法律专家；评估存在作者兼任评估者的主观偏差风险，且单一产品案例限制了对其他行业的外部有效性。代码与评估界面已开源，工业数据因保密性暂未公开。

title: Trace-Based Execution-Level Observability of VDM-SL Specifications
summary: VDM has been pursuing rigorous verification through mathematical theorem proving and software testing via simulated execution. Animation through an interpreter enables validation of the specification to ensure it meets the required functionality. Step-by-step execution in a debugger also allows the user to follow the internal behavior of operations. In this paper, we propose the recording and utilization of execution traces of assignments, operation calls, and return statements to make the internal behavior of operations persistent and analyzable as state-based models. The data model of events in execution traces, its implementation in ViennaTalk, and its application to visualization will be introduced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于执行轨迹（execution trace）的VDM-SL规范可观测性方法，通过记录赋值、操作调用和返回事件形成基于状态的模型，并在ViennaTalk IDE中实现，配合Mermaid生成序列图和状态图以支持可视化分析。
AI.motivation: VDM-SL的不变量、前置/后置条件断言只能在单个执行步骤检查状态，无法表达跨越多个执行步骤的属性；现有的动画执行和调试器虽然能跟踪内部行为，但缺乏将内部行为持久化、可分析的形式化手段。该研究旨在补充VDM断言机制的不足，使具体执行的内部行为成为可持久检查的对象，以支持探索性规范阶段的反馈收集与利益相关者沟通。
AI.method: 定义树形结构的执行轨迹数据模型：根事件包含初始状态和事件序列，事件分为AssignEvent、OpCallEvent、OpReturnEvent三种类型；通过VDM-SL到Pharo的转译，在生成代码中嵌入探针（probe），利用Pharo的slot机制在状态变量读写时插入追踪代码；事件通过统一的recorder对象收集；基于该轨迹，使用Mermaid记法生成序列图和状态图，并通过执行轨迹查看器提供分层GUI和时间旅行调试功能。
AI.result: 在ViennaTalk中实现了完整的执行轨迹记录机制与Execution Trace Viewer，支持层次树形浏览与Step/Back/Dive/Caller时间旅行导航；通过自动门（Automatic Door）示例演示了序列图与状态图的生成；发现连续赋值产生的中间状态导致状态图中出现重复环路，使用atomic关键字封装为多重赋值后问题得以解决；支持CSV导入导出与Mermaid脚本嵌入Markdown文档。
AI.conclusion: 执行轨迹的记录将瞬态状态和操作激活具象化为持久对象，并成功通过序列图与状态图进行可视化；未来工作将设计针对事件序列的查询语言，以表达跨越多个执行步骤的时序属性，并探索将CSP等进程代数用于运行时验证与回归测试中的多版本规范对比。

title: Garbage Collection and Energy Consumption in Java: A Controlled Study Across Workloads and JDKs
summary: Garbage-collector selection is a low-effort configuration decision that can influence both the performance and energy consumption of Java applications. However, it remains unclear whether aggregate energy rankings among collectors generalise across heterogeneous applications, workload intensities, and JDK distributions. This study presents a controlled empirical evaluation of Serial, Parallel, and G1 garbage collection across three Java applications, three workload intensities, and two JDK distributions: OpenJDK and Oracle JDK. Using EnergiBridge, processor-package energy consumption and execution time were measured and complementary energy-performance metrics derived. Across all evaluated configurations, Parallel recorded the lowest mean energy consumption (839.8 J), followed closely by Serial (857.6 J) and G1 (969.0 J), but an RCBD ANOVA did not establish a statistically reliable collector effect. Workload intensity, by contrast, was a significant driver of energy consumption, with heavy workloads consuming substantially more energy than light or medium workloads regardless of collector. Energy consumption showed a moderate positive association with execution time (r = 0.33), indicating that longer-running configurations tended toward higher energy use, though the relationship was far from proportional. No statistically significant energy difference was found between OpenJDK and Oracle JDK. Overall, the results do not support a universally energy-optimal garbage collector; instead, workload intensity emerges as the more reliable lever for managing Java energy consumption, and collector selection should be treated as an application-specific tuning decision supported by measurement on the target system rather than aggregate rankings alone.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Java 应用中三种垃圾收集器（Serial、Parallel、G1）在不同应用、工作负载强度和 JDK 发行版下的能耗进行了受控实证研究。结果显示 Parallel 描述性平均能耗最低（839.8 J），但 RCBD ANOVA 未建立统计上可靠的收集器效应；工作负载强度才是能耗的显著驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 能源效率正成为软件工程的重要质量关注点，而垃圾收集器（GC）的选择是一项无需修改代码的低成本配置决策。Shimchenko 等人先前研究表明替换默认 G1 可降低能耗，但尚不清楚基于聚合的 GC 能耗排名能否在不同应用、工作负载强度和 JDK 发行版下泛化，因此需要一种受控的统计评估来验证收集器选择的稳健性。
AI.method: 采用随机完全区组设计（RCBD），以 Java 应用为主区组：3 种 GC（Serial/Parallel/G1）× 3 个应用（Spring PetClinic、REST To-Do、ANDIE）× 3 个工作负载强度（轻/中/重）× 2 个 JDK（OpenJDK/Oracle JDK）× 4 次重复 = 216 次运行。使用 EnergiBridge 采集 RAPL 处理器封装能耗与执行时间，衍生平均功率和能耗-延迟积（EDP）。由于仅剩 3 个区组，将 subject 视为固定效应进行全因子 RCBD ANOVA 分析，并配合 Tukey 事后比较。
AI.result: （1）描述性均值：Parallel 839.8 J < Serial 857.6 J < G1 969.0 J，但 GC 主效应不显著（F(2,202)=0.65, p=0.524），Tukey 配对比较均不显著；（2）工作负载强度显著影响能耗（F(2,202)=13.18, p<0.001），Heavy（1229.7 J）显著高于 Medium（830.0 J）和 Light（606.7 J）；（3）GC×工作负载交互作用不显著；（4）能耗-执行时间呈中等正相关（r=0.33，p<0.001）；（5）OpenJDK（863.2 J）与 Oracle JDK（914.3 J）无显著差异；（6）方差分解显示工作负载占 11.1%、残差占 85.4%，GC 仅占 0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普适的"能耗最优"垃圾收集器。聚合层面的 GC 排名差异虽可见但缺乏统计稳健性，不能作为通用建议。工作负载强度是管理 Java 能耗更可靠的杠杆，收集器选择应作为面向特定应用的调优决策，并结合目标系统上的实测来支持，而非依赖聚合排名。JDK 发行版间的能耗差异在本实验中也未得到统计支持。

title: Auditing and Decomposing Feedback-Driven Evolution in LLM Test Generation under the Oracle Problem
summary: Execution feedback is often treated as a self-verifying signal for improving LLM-generated tests. However, when generated inputs are executed on a single accepted program and its outputs are used as ground truth, invalid or underspecified inputs can create spurious fault detections and apparent evolutionary gains. We audit this failure mode in feedback-driven test generation using 142 development tasks, 114 locked external tasks, and 138 held-out tasks, with two code models, three seeds, and fault-cross-fitted real submissions. On external inputs for which three accepted implementations agree, generated outputs match the panel on only 27.79% and 50.12% of cases. A single-reference oracle inflates the measured gain from evolution by 9.46-14.85 percentage points; after auditing, equal-budget independent resampling outperforms mutation-based evolution by 6.01-18.83 points. We further compare a genuine three-round feedback loop with a density-matched placebo. External Real-Placebo differences are +0.13 and -0.50 points, while held-out differences are +1.99 and +0.28 points and do not provide robust evidence of fine-grained feedback benefit. A blinded semantic audit by two software engineering doctoral students classifies 94.41% of panel-disconfirmed inputs as invalid but 3.60% as valid, showing that panel disagreement is informative but not semantic proof. We propose an audit-and-placebo protocol that separates verifier artifacts, interaction scaffolding, and grounded feedback credit in evaluations of self-evolving test generators.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了基于LLM的自演化测试生成中"执行反馈作为自验证信号"的失效模式。通过在394个任务（142开发+114外部+138保留）、两个Qwen代码模型、三个随机种子上的系统实验，发现单一参考实现会人为抬高演化增益9.46–14.85个百分点；经多实现审计和等预算对比，独立重采样比基于变异的演化高出6.01–18.83个百分点；三轮反馈循环中，行为对齐反馈的增量价值在保留下来的修正后保留队列上并不稳健（不满足预设等价性或优效性规则）。两位软件工程博士生盲审300个面板不一致输入，94.41%被判为无效但3.60%为有效。作者提出了一种审计-安慰剂协议来分离验证器伪影、交互支架和可归因的反馈贡献。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的测试常将执行反馈视为自验证信号，特别是在算法竞赛场景下将单个已接受程序的输出当作真值（ground truth）。然而当输入不合法或未充分规约（underspecified）时，这种"单一参考预言机"会把越界行为转化为虚假的故障检测，从而在自演化循环中被反复选择蒸馏，产生虚假的"学习"进步。研究动机在于：揭示并量化这一预言机问题如何系统性膨胀自演化测试生成的报告增益，并回答"保留的行为对齐执行反馈是否真的带来价值"这一根本问题。
AI.method: 研究采用六问题的实证审计设计：(1) 在142开发任务和114外部TestCase-Eval任务上审计直接预言机可靠性；(2) 比较"单一参考"与"多实现审计"下的演化增益差异，并定义增益膨胀度量I(E,O)；(3) 在相同候选预算下对比一次生成(Evolve:1+6变异)与三次独立调用(Matched)的方法排名；(4) 将2,836个真实故障按触发表型（公共例、官方锚点、安全变体、不安全变体、硬残差）分解；(5) 两位软件工程博士生盲审300个面板不一致输入（150开发+150外部）进行五类语义判定（valid/out-of-domain/malformed/ambiguous/insufficient）；(6) 对比三轮真实反馈循环与密度匹配的安慰剂反馈（保留迭代提示、历史大小、检测集基数与杀敌密度但随机化输入-故障映射），并在保留队列E16-B（138任务，资格修订后）上做结果盲检验。统计上采用任务级非参数配对bootstrap（20,000次重抽样），使用SHA-256哈希锁定所有制品、任务、折叠、分析脚本，对外部执行采用bubblewrap命名空间隔离。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) RQ1：在三实现一致同意的外部可接受输入上，模型生成的输出仅在27.79%（Qwen2.5）和50.12%（Qwen3.5）情况下与面板吻合，全套面板确认比例仅2.53%和5.07%；(2) RQ2：单一参考下Evolve对One-shot的表面增益为10.58–13.38 pp（开发）和11.58–12.57 pp（外部），审计后降至-1.47至2.18 pp，增益膨胀达9.46–14.85 pp（所有95%区间严格大于零）；(3) RQ3：审计后Matched在所有四个模型-队列条件下均超过Evolve 6.01–18.83 pp；(4) RQ4：仅11.28%的故障由"不安全变异"触发，其中84.52–92.45%被审计否决，而安全变异家族检测更稳健；(5) RQ5：盲审一致率91.67%（κ=.823），按设计加权后94.41%被判无效、3.60%被判有效；(6) RQ6：E14/E15外部队列上Real-Placebo对比为+0.13和-0.50 pp（区间过零）；E16-B保留队列上为+1.99 pp（[+0.08, +3.88]）和+0.28 pp（[-1.41, +2.03]），两者均不满足预冻结的±2 pp等价或优效规则；候选收益匹配回放将正面对比反转至-0.30和+0.78 pp。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是"执行并非无条件验证"：单一已接受实现既未提供有效输入域，也未提供充分预言机，其输出可将域外行为转化为表面故障检测，重复优化则把这种验证器伪影固化为学习信号；审计后的排名显示独立重采样优于基于变异的演化；交互式循环的模型相关差异主要可由密度匹配的安慰剂解释，行为对齐反馈的增量价值在修正后的保留队列上未被稳健建立，但作者也不声称执行反馈普遍无用，而仅将其作为支架/粗粒度进度之外的细粒度归属仍未解决。作者据此提出四项评估保障：冻结后审计、匹配搜索与反馈接口、分离选择与评估、采用可执行契约而非将面板分歧直接等同于语义错误。论文的贡献是诊断性的协议（审计-安慰剂流程），而非新生成器，为未来自演化测试生成器的SFT/RLHF更新评估提供了可复制的基线。

title: A Fully Automated, Deployment-Aware Testing Pipeline for IoT-Based Automotive Applications
comment: Submitted, accepted and presented at IoTBDS26
summary: Testing embedded software in modern vehicles is challenging due to system complexity, decentralized architectures, and strict safety and performance constraints. In this work, we present an end-to-end, deployment-aware testing pipeline for IoT-based automotive applications. The pipeline combines requirement-driven test and code generation with large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) assistance, and human-in-the-loop curation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Using Eclipse openDuT, it supports flexible, distributed deployment across geographically separated cyber-physical and IoT infrastructures, optimizing for node availability and cross-organizational coordination. For validation, we conduct a case study using a Child Presence Detection System (CPDS), achieving full functional requirement coverage across all 9 requirements and 100% Gherkin generation accuracy on the controlled requirement set. Distributed test execution across geographically separated ECUs via Eclipse openDuT confirms the pipeline's applicability to OEM--supplier testing workflows.

AI.tldr: This paper presents a fully automated, deployment-aware testing pipeline for IoT-based automotive applications that uses LLM/VLM-assisted requirement-to-code generation, Eclipse openDuT for distributed orchestration, and Ansible for deployment. It was validated on a Child Presence Detection System (CPDS) case study, achieving 100% Gherkin generation accuracy on a controlled 9-requirement set and full functional requirement coverage across three distributed ECUs.
AI.motivation: Modern automotive software testing faces challenges from system complexity, decentralized ECU architectures, global OEM–supplier coordination, and strict safety/performance requirements. Traditional standards (ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE) lack automated, infrastructure-aware testing support for IoT-based architectures, and manual workflows dominate, leading to late integration, high iteration costs, and poor traceability. The authors aim to reduce manual authoring effort and enable early, distributed, end-to-end testing across geographically separated ECUs.
AI.method: The pipeline consists of six stages: (1) requirements definition in natural language and UML diagrams; (2) test case generation using a GPT-4 class LLM (with Chain-of-Thought and Few-Shot prompting) to produce Gherkin scenarios and Python test scripts, and a VLM (Gemini 2.5 Pro / Qwen 2.5 VL) to extract signals from UML diagrams, with human-in-the-loop curation; (3) deployment using lightweight network profiling (RTT, packet loss) to compute a normalized connection_strength score, with Ansible orchestration and Eclipse openDuT (backed by NetBird/WireGuard) for distributed connectivity; (4) execution via a central REST controller with gRPC inter-ECU messaging, using JSON test definitions; (5) reporting with UUID-tagged JSON artifacts and a traceability matrix linking scenarios to requirements; (6) undeployment via inverse Ansible playbooks. The prototype is implemented as CI/CD on GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners, using MongoDB for storage and Python/unittest for test execution. The CPDS case study was instantiated with three virtual ECUs (doors, HVAC, infotainment) and 9 functional + 5 technical requirements.
AI.result: On the controlled CPDS requirement set (9 functional + 5 technical requirements), the GPT-4 class model achieved 100% Gherkin generation accuracy with no manual correction. Drawing on the companion study [40], at finer industry-scale granularity (36 requirements), 32 (89%) were automatically transformed into executable Gherkin without modification, with 1–5 min/review for scenarios and 5–20 min for code adaptation. The traceability matrix showed full coverage of FR1–FR9 across 7 test scenarios. Connectivity profiling produced a connection_strength of 0.999 for ecu_2 with 0.06 ms average RTT and zero packet loss. Automated deployment, execution across three ECUs via openDuT, result aggregation, and undeployment all completed successfully, validating end-to-end OEM–supplier workflow applicability. Limitations include GitHub Actions coupling, Windows-only runners, sequential execution, and MongoDB scalability concerns.
AI.conclusion: The pipeline uniquely combines three properties not jointly provided by prior work: LLM/VLM-assisted test generation from natural-language requirements and UML diagrams, deployment-aware orchestration driven by live network profiling, and full requirements-to-result traceability across distributed IoT-grade automotive ECU topologies. It reduces manual effort, supports early integration testing, and demonstrated operational feasibility in a CPDS case study. Future work will focus on parallel execution, smarter scheduling based on connection_strength, fault tolerance, containerized platform independence, SOTIF (ISO 21448) coverage, fault-injection scenarios, and open-source release of the prototype.

title: PRAXIS: Graph-Grounded Tacit Knowledge for Domain Code Generation
summary: LLM agents have achieved strong performance on general software engineering tasks, yet struggle with domain-specific code generation. We identify the root cause as the agent's lack of tacit knowledge, including domain-specific business rules, interface contracts, and operational conventions that developers internalize through practice but never document. This knowledge is deeply buried beneath the domain code, dispersed across code entities and their dependency relations, and invisible to the agent that lacks it. These properties make tacit knowledge inherently difficult to retrieve or learn. In this work, we propose PRAXIS, a framework that enables agents to systematically extract, represent, and reuse tacit knowledge for domain code generation. PRAXIS acquires tacit knowledge by simulating human development workflows within the target codebase, distills it into structured units organized on the code dependency graph, and proactively surfaces it to the agent at the point of code interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PRAXIS outperforms state-of-the-art agents equipped with powerful agentic search capabilities, as well as experience-based and skill-based methods. The approach integrates seamlessly into various agent frameworks and LLMs with consistent performance improvements, and supports continual evolution with performance steadily scaling as practice accumulates.

AI.tldr: PRAXIS是一个面向领域代码生成的框架，通过在目标代码库中模拟人类开发实践来提取、组织和复用隐性知识（tacit knowledge），将这些知识以依赖图为锚点进行组织，并在智能体编码时主动注入相关内容。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM智能体在通用软件工程任务上表现强劲，但在领域特定代码生成任务上性能急剧下降。根本原因在于智能体缺乏隐性知识——开发者通过实践内化但从未文档化的领域特定业务规则、接口契约和操作约定。这种知识深埋于代码之下、分散在代码实体及其依赖关系中，且不知其缺失的智能体不会主动寻求，导致难以检索或学习。
AI.method: PRAXIS通过四个渐进阶段解决挑战：（1）领域内开发实践——让智能体在目标代码库中实际编写代码、遇到错误并迭代修改，通过行为差异暴露隐性知识；（2）结构化知识获取——将实践轨迹中的差异提炼为包含触发器、内容、证据和置信度的四元组程序性记忆单元；（3）基于图的知识组织——将知识锚定到依赖图中的代码实体，并沿依赖边双向传播，合并等价单元并解决冲突；（4）隐性知识注入——分任务初始化注入和交互触发注入两步，主动将相关知识推送给智能体。框架还支持在线持续演化，根据任务成败动态更新知识置信度。
AI.result: 在KoCo-Bench基准上，PRAXIS平均Pass@1达32.06%，比次优基线相对提升16.7%；消融实验表明四个阶段均贡献显著，其中开发实践阶段贡献最大；跨智能体框架（OpenHands、SWE-Agent）和不同LLM（DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5.5、Qwen3.6）均表现稳定增益；在AInsteinBench的科学计算代码错误修复任务上也保持泛化；性能随实践函数数量增加稳定提升，在线演化也带来持续改善。人类评估显示提取的知识在内容真实性（4.28）、触发准确性（4.24）、证据可追溯性（3.62）方面质量较高，置信度与人工评分的Spearman相关性达0.75。
AI.conclusion: PRAXIS将隐性知识识别为领域代码生成的根本瓶颈，通过开发实践提取、依赖图结构化组织和主动注入，有效弥补了智能体在领域代码生成中的知识缺口。该方法训练免费，可叠加于任何现有智能体框架和LLM之上，并具备性能随实践积累而持续提升的能力。随着通用代码生成能力快速进步，通过实践获取和积累领域专长将成为自主软件工程智能体的核心能力。

title: Further Progress Towards Operation Proof Obligation Generation for VDM
summary: The VDM formalism can ensure that models are internally consistent. Potential inconsistencies are highlighted by assertions called proof obligations. This paper is an update to the work described in [1], regarding proof obligation generation for VDM operations. We present the latest work which improves the approach to loop invariants, adds loop variants, improves proof obligations for operation calls, including implicitly declared operations and specification statements, and adds recursive measures for operations. The new features are illustrated with examples.

AI.tldr: 本文是关于VDM（维也纳开发方法）操作式证明义务生成（POG）工具的进展更新。研究改进了循环不变量处理（支持更复杂的嵌套循环及三种for循环类型）、新增循环变体（用于证明终止性）、改进了操作调用的证明义务生成（包括隐式操作声明和规格说明语句），并增加了操作的递归度量支持。通过在大型VDM-SL规格库上测试，"UNCHECKED"证明义务比例从9.6%降至2.4%。同时介绍了VDM-VSCode工具中的CodeLens集成，用于显示依赖性证明义务和QuickCheck结果。
AI.motivation: VDM形式化方法可通过证明义务（POs）识别模型中潜在的运行时错误。虽然函数式的POG工具支持已较为成熟，但操作式POG因控制流更复杂（涉及循环、操作调用、异常和状态变更）而支持有限。本文旨在推进操作式证明义务生成的最新进展，解决先前方法中循环不变量扩展性差、操作调用后状态变量被标记为"模糊"、缺乏递归操作度量等问题。
AI.method: 方法核心是通过注释驱动POG：使用@LoopInvariant和@LoopMeasure注释处理循环（while循环及三种for循环：for-index、for-set、for-seq），其中for-set和for-seq使用"幽灵变量"追踪已处理元素；操作调用采用传递闭包计算可能更新的变量，将其量化后用被调操作的前/后置条件限定；递归操作通过@OperationMeasure注释生成measure函数用于终止性证明。VDM-VSCode工具中新增CodeLens和InlayHint以增强交互性。
AI.result: 在包含7000多个证明义务的大型VDM-SL规格语料库上进行测试，操作式POG产生的"UNCHECKED"结果比例从之前工作的9.6%降至2.4%。QuickCheck工具成功验证了递归阶乘示例中的错误（a=0时因a=1而非a<=1的退出条件失败）。VDM-VSCode工具通过CodeLens实现了按约束过滤依赖性PO、通过悬停元素展示QuickCheck诊断信息、以及缺失PO警告的可视化展示。
AI.conclusion: 本文在VDM操作式证明义务生成方面取得了显著进展，有效降低了无法检查的PO比例。未来工作需要解决：异常处理语句（always、trap、tixe）、变量隐藏导致的无效PO、POG自身的正确性验证、VDM++/VDM-RT的复杂状态与控制流、表达式中无法静态确定顺序的多次操作调用、跨模块调用时的本地状态更新问题，以及通过变量切片简化复杂PO和为约束设计提供更好的工具支持。

title: Evaluating Automated Testing on an Open-Source Web Application Using Cypress
comment: Accepted by the 9th International Conference on Research in Engineering and Technology (RET 2026)
summary: End-to-end automated testing is increasingly used in web software development to ensure system quality and shorten response times during development. However, the true effectiveness of automated testing depends on many factors including execution time, stability of test results, and maintainability of the test suite as the application continues to evolve. In this paper, we evaluate the effectiveness of end-to-end automated testing using the Cypress framework for an open-source web application. We deployed the experiment with 27 test cases. The test's effectiveness is measured by execution speed, reliability, and maintainability. The experimental results show that the Cypress-based end-to-end test suite has short and stable execution times. It suits frequent runs during software development. The majority of test cases achieved consistent results across multiple runs, while flakiness only occurred in a few tests which involve complex interactive functions. Furthermore, the study highlights the impact of element locator strategies and Page Object Model (POM) architecture on test suite maintainability, demonstrating that resilient data-cy attributes significantly reduce maintenance overhead when UI changes occur.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一个开源 Web 应用,使用 Cypress 框架部署了 27 个端到端自动化测试用例,从执行速度、可靠性(稳定性/抗抖动性)和可维护性三个维度评估其有效性。实验表明:基于 Cypress 的端到端测试套件具有较短且稳定的执行时间,适合在软件开发过程中频繁运行;大多数测试用例多次运行结果一致,仅少数涉及复杂交互功能的测试出现抖动(flakiness);此外,研究表明元素定位策略(如 data-cy 属性)和页面对象模型(POM)架构对测试套件可维护性有显著影响,使用弹性 data-cy 属性可大幅降低 UI 变更带来的维护开销。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动化测试在 Web 软件开发中应用日益广泛,以保障系统质量并缩短开发响应时间。然而,自动化测试的真实效能受执行时间、结果稳定性以及测试套件随应用演化的可维护性等多因素影响。当前对这些因素的综合实证评估仍有限,尤其是针对 Cypress 这一较新框架在真实开源项目中的表现缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 研究选取一个开源 Web 应用作为实验对象,采用 Cypress 框架编写并部署了 27 个端到端测试用例。从三个维度评估测试有效性:① 执行速度——测量测试运行耗时;② 可靠性(稳定性)——通过多次重复运行测试用例,观察结果一致性与抖动(flakiness)情况;③ 可维护性——分析元素定位策略(如 data-cy 属性)与页面对象模型(POM)架构在 UI 变更场景下对维护成本的影响。
AI.result: 1) 执行速度:基于 Cypress 的测试套件执行时间短且稳定,适合开发过程中频繁运行;2) 可靠性:绝大多数测试用例在多次运行中结果一致,仅少数涉及复杂交互功能(如异步操作、动态 UI 等)的测试出现抖动;3) 可维护性:采用 data-cy 等弹性属性作为元素定位策略,并结合 POM 架构组织测试代码,可在 UI 发生变更时显著降低维护开销,提升测试套件的可持续演化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明,Cypress 框架在端到端自动化测试中具备良好的执行效率与结果可靠性,能够满足持续开发与频繁运行的需求;同时,合理的元素定位策略(data-cy 属性)与 POM 架构是保障测试套件长期可维护性的关键实践。但对于包含复杂交互功能的测试场景,仍需关注并缓解抖动问题。该研究为开发者在实践中选用 Cypress、设计稳健测试套件提供了实证依据与实践指导。

title: BreakGuard: Towards Detecting Dependency Breaking Changes with LLM-Generated Tests
summary: Open-source libraries play an important role in software development by providing reusable features that expedite the development process. As libraries evolve, they release new versions that add features, fix bugs, or apply security patches. In this process, they may break the contract established with their clients by introducing breaking changes (BCs) that alter the runtime behavior and break client applications. Client-side test suites often fail to detect these BCs because of limited library coverage that does not exercise all library methods used in the client's codebase. We propose BreakGuard, an approach that generates a test suite to detect breaking changes in clients. BreakGuard statically extracts every client method (focal method) that invokes the target library method (call site), then generates tests per focal method. A test detects a BC if it passes on the pre-breaking version and fails on the breaking version. We evaluate our approach on 89 real-world breaking changes from the BUMP dataset, using 3 LLMs (GPT4o, Qwen3-coder-480B, GPT-OSS-120B) and three context levels: minimal, method, and class. Using the best-performing configuration, BreakGuard detects 30.3% of breaking changes (27 of 89) at a mean cost of roughly $0.90 USD per detected breaking change. We successfully detected BCs from different library categories (e.g., JSON libraries, logging, parsing), but we find LLM-generated tests to be more reliable for detecting crash-type breaking changes as opposed to behavioural BCs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BreakGuard，一种利用 LLM 为客户端代码中每个调用目标库的"焦点方法"自动生成测试套件的框架，通过在升级前后两个版本上分别执行生成的测试来检测依赖项破坏性变更（BC）。基于 BUMP 数据集中的 89 个真实 Java 破坏性更新实例，作者评估了三种 LLM（GPT-4o、Qwen3-Coder-480B、GPT-OSS-120B）与三种上下文级别（Minimal、Method、Class）的组合，最佳配置（GPT-4o + Class 上下文）以约 $0.90/检测的代价成功识别 30.3%（27/89）的破坏性变更。
AI.motivation: 开源库升级频繁引入破坏性变更（BC），但客户端测试套件因对库的覆盖率有限而难以发现；现有静态 API 兼容性分析只能检测签名级变化，语义差异分析又依赖稀缺的形式化规约；现有 LLM 测试生成工作主要针对内部程序逻辑，尚未有研究评估 LLM 生成测试在跨版本依赖升级中检测破坏性变更的有效性。
AI.method: BreakGuard 采用三阶段流水线：(1) 静态分析阶段——基于 Spoon 构建 AST，扫描客户端源码，过滤导入目标库的包前缀的文件，提取每个调用目标库方法的"焦点方法"及其库调用点（方法名、参数类型/表达式、返回类型、签名）和类型引用；(2) 提示构造阶段——为每个焦点方法构建包含元数据、程序上下文、测试格式、目标与约束、可选附加上下文的五段式提示；附加上下文分三个变体：Minimal（仅签名）、Method（完整方法源码）、Class（整个类源码）；(3) 测试生成与执行阶段——LLM 单次生成测试文件，采用两阶段 Docker 执行流水线（先编译后执行），分别在 pre-breaking 和 breaking 版本上运行，通过测试结果差异判定 BC。在 89 个 BUMP 实例上比较 3×3=9 种（模型×上下文）配置，使用 temperature=0 保证可复现性。
AI.result: 有效性（RQ1）：Qwen3-Coder + Class 上下文覆盖最多焦点方法（22.4%），但仅 33.5% 测试可编译；GPT-4o + Class 上下文在 BUMP 实例层面覆盖率达 34.8%；编译失败是主要失效原因（平均 79.7%）。检测能力（RQ2）：最佳配置 GPT-4o + Class 上下文检测出 27/89（30.3%）的 BC，Qwen3-Coder 检测出 20/89（22.5%）；不同上下文可检测出部分独有 BC，检测集中在 Logging API 和 JSON 库两大类别。失败类型（RQ3）：95.1% 的检测来自 ERROR（运行时错误），主要是 NoClassDefFoundError（42.5%）、NoSuchMethodError（29.0%）、ClassNotFoundException（28.5%）；仅 4.9% 为 FAILURE（断言失败），其中 77.3% 使用 assertDoesNotThrow 等仅验证执行成功的断言，仅 25 个测试（0.7%）使用基于值的断言检测行为变更。成本（RQ4）：中位成本范围 $0.001–$0.088/BUMP 实例，GPT-4o + Class 上下文均值 $0.90/检测；Class 上下文相比 Minimal 上下文 token 消耗增加 3–4 倍。未检测分析显示 78.4% 的失效测试从未加载过被破坏的 API 类。
AI.conclusion: BreakGuard 证明了 LLM 生成测试可用于在依赖升级前主动检测破坏性变更，Class 上下文在检测能力与成本之间提供最佳权衡。然而当前方法主要捕获崩溃型（结构型）BC，对行为型 BC 检测能力有限；编译失败率高（~66–98%）构成可恢复的下界，未来工作可通过智能体反馈循环修复编译错误；建议结合依赖图感知的焦点方法选择以精准定位受变更影响的 API；当前结果作为单次提示基线，其他生态系统（npm、pip、Cargo）的泛化性有待验证。

title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
summary: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions.
